jobs.title: Senior Developer Advocate, Developer Education
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Durable execution changes how you build software. It makes applications reliable by default, but it's a genuinely new way to think, so most developers meet it with a lot of questions. Developer Education exists to answer them. We take a developer from their first "what is this?" to running production-grade Temporal applications, along a guided journey that gets them hands-on from the first step.

We treat education as a product, not a side project. It's a serious, resourced effort to build something that can genuinely move the business. You'll help build the platform behind it and shape where it goes, not just create content to fill it. You'll work within real technology constraints, but with plenty of room to get creative.

We're building that journey now: exercise-first courses, video, and AI-assisted learning that meets developers the way they actually work. AI runs through both how we teach and what we teach. Durable execution is fast becoming the backbone for reliable AI agents, and we're building the content that shows developers how.

As a Senior Developer Advocate on the team, you're a strong engineer who teaches through working code and through story. Great teaching carries someone from confusion to understanding, and you turn hard distributed-systems ideas into experiences that click. You'll also partner across Developer Relations, Product, Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales, and Marketing to help developers succeed with Temporal.

What You'll Do

  • Help shape the education platform and the direction of the learning experience, not just the content that fills it

  • Design and build exercise-first courses, tutorials, and labs where a working, hands-on example is the core, with video, guides, and learning paths built around it

  • Produce video education content, including long-form walkthroughs and short-form "aha moment" clips

  • Build hands-on AI and agent content, including durable AI agent examples that show how Temporal underpins reliable AI systems

  • Design learning experiences that reflect modern developer workflows, including AI-assisted, hybrid, and interactive formats

  • Keep educational materials aligned with current product capabilities and recommended architectural patterns

  • Build and maintain reference implementations, labs, and best-practices examples for common developer and enterprise scenarios, in one or more Temporal SDK languages

  • Occasionally represent education in person: staffing a booth at a conference or event, and now and then standing up to teach a group directly, through a workshop, a training session, or a talk.

  • Partner with enterprise-facing teams (Solutions Architecture, Sales, Field Marketing, Developer Success) to turn their needs into reusable educational assets such as workshops, deep dives, and enablement material that scale beyond a single customer rather than one-off engagements

  • Help run trainer certification and developer certification programs by supporting competency definitions, assessment creation, and iteration based on feedback

  • Collect and share developer feedback from trainings, events, and community channels, and share actionable insights with Product and Engineering to improve education strategy and product direction

What You'll Bring

  • Strong software engineering background and the ability to build production-quality, real working examples in at least one of Temporal's primary SDK languages (Go, Java, TypeScript, Python, or .NET)

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including state management, fault tolerance, concurrency, and event-driven architectures

  • Demonstrated experience creating high-quality technical education content (tutorials, workshops, courses, docs, or similar) for developer audiences

  • Clear, pragmatic communication, written and verbal, for technical and mixed audiences, with a storyteller's instinct: you teach through narrative, not a list of features

  • Ability to operate as a senior individual contributor: take ownership of projects, drive them forward with minimal direction, and iterate quickly based on feedback

  • A product and ownership instinct: you think about the whole learner experience and the platform, not just the asset in front of you

  • Comfort balancing execution with program-level thinking, including cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Developer Success, Marketing, and Solutions Architecture

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for conferences, events, customer trainings, and team offsites

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Temporal or another workflow orchestration system

  • Background in developer education, developer relations, or technical enablement

  • Open source contributions, especially in developer tooling, distributed systems, or adjacent ecosystems

  • Experience building LLM-powered applications or AI agents, and a feel for the reliability problems they hit at scale (state, failure, long-running orchestration).

  • Experience with a learning management system (LMS) or building an education platform

  • Experience working in a remote-first, globally distributed company

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Ecosystem
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

AI teams are assembling their stacks from a fast-moving set of best-in-class tools — model providers, agent SDKs, evaluation and observability platforms, cloud services. Temporal is the durable execution layer that ties those pieces together and makes them production-grade. That position is a strategic advantage, and it needs a dedicated owner.

As Staff Product Manager, AI Ecosystem, you own Temporal's integrations and partnerships product portfolio — the surfaces where Temporal meets the rest of the AI stack. You'll define how Temporal is better together with best-in-class tools (eg, from OpenAI, Google, AWS, Braintrust, and more), and how Temporal becomes the durable foundation developers reach for from prototype to production.

This is a role where shipping the integration code is just the beginning. You'll drive business leverage through the narrative, the reference architectures, the enablement, and the sustained momentum that make an integration matter to customers and to the field. You'll partner with Engineering, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Sales, Solutions Architecture, and DevRel to take products to market and drive real adoption.

Location: San Francisco Bay Area (strongly preferred); remote (US) considered with heavier travel

What You'll Do

  • Own the integrations & partnerships product roadmap. Identify, prioritize, and sequence the integrations and partner experiences that make Temporal the execution layer of choice across the AI stack, and make the hard calls about what not to build.

  • Stay in the market daily. Be in customer conversations constantly and track a fast-moving AI tooling landscape. Turn what you learn into a roadmap grounded in real, current user needs.

  • Help define the "Temporal for AI" ecosystem story. Work with cross-functional partners to drive the positioning, reference architectures, and composable building blocks that help AI engineers see how Temporal fits their architecture — prescriptive enough to be useful, adaptable enough to fit their stack.

  • Take products to market with GTM. Partner with internal GTM (Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Architecture, DevRel) and with partner GTM orgs to launch integrations and drive adoption.

  • Drive internal enablement. Make sure the field knows how to sell, deploy, and support every integration in the portfolio. Help build the demos, talk tracks, and reference materials at the right altitude.

  • Define and track success. Set the KPIs that tell us whether the ecosystem strategy is working. Our priors is that early-stage ecosystem bets are measured by adoption and momentum, not immediate revenue.

What You'll Bring

  • Staff-level product ownership. You take an ambiguous strategic question and turn it into a roadmap and shipped outcomes with minimal direction. 8+ years in product management or an equivalent track record.

  • Deep AI fluency. You are hands-on with the AI tooling landscape (eg, agent frameworks and SDKs, model providers, eval and observability tools) and you have an opinionated, well-reasoned view of where it's going. If you're not touching this technology regularly, you'll fall behind, and this role can't afford that.

  • Ecosystem, platform, or partnerships product experience. You've owned integrations, a developer platform, or partner-facing products, not just end-user features.

  • GTM partnership instincts. You've worked hand-in-hand with Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Architecture, and external partners to launch products and drive adoption, and you can enable a field organization to sell something new.

  • Technical literacy. You reason fluently about AI systems, and can hold your own in a design conversation with Staff engineers. You don't need to write production code.

  • Narrative-grade writing. You build stories. You can write the document that aligns an organization and changes what it invests in.

Nice to Have

  • Background in distributed systems, durable execution, or workflow orchestration

  • Hands-on experience with Temporal or comparable systems

  • Prior DevRel, field-facing, or technical-marketing-adjacent experience

  • A track record of building reference architectures or developer enablement programs

Why Temporal

  • You'll shape how the industry builds AI. Temporal's position underneath the AI stack is rare and strategically valuable. You'll own a meaningful part of it.

  • Deeply involved in AI. We power many of the biggest names in the space, and partner with the companies defining it.

  • Open source at the core, a strong engineering culture, and a developer-first mission.

  • Well-funded with a strong growth trajectory.

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. jobs.title: Account Executive, Growth - Scale (West)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal is shaping the future of application development by enabling organizations to build, scale, and run resilient applications. We are seeking a technically curious Account Executive with a growth mindset to join our GTM organization and accelerate expansion within a portfolio of high-potential customers.

This role sits on our Growth Scale team, focused on deepening and expanding existing customer relationships as they scale their use of Temporal across teams, use cases, and business units. You will work with technically sophisticated organizations that are already seeing value from Temporal and help guide them from early adoption to broader, long-term commitments.

As a Growth AE, you will navigate increasingly complex account structures, partner closely with Solutions Architects and Customer Success, and engage a range of personas from software engineers to engineering leadership and business decision-makers. This role is ideal for sellers who thrive in land-and-expand motions, enjoy technical problem-solving, and want to grow their skills operating in larger, more complex environments.

You’ll play a critical role in driving durable revenue growth while helping customers build resilient systems with Temporal. We value diverse perspectives and believe great sellers are built through curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage expansion opportunities within a defined book of business, driving increased adoption and revenue growth.

  • Develop and execute thoughtful account plans to expand Temporal’s footprint across teams, workflows, and business units.

  • Engage deeply with technical stakeholders including software engineers, architects, and engineering leaders to understand evolving use cases and challenges.

  • Translate technical value into business impact, aligning Temporal’s capabilities to customer priorities and outcomes.

  • Navigate increasingly complex sales cycles, including multi-threading across technical, economic, and executive stakeholders.

  • Build trusted, long-term customer relationships and act as a strategic partner throughout the customer lifecycle.

  • Partner closely with Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to deliver a cohesive customer experience.

  • Identify growth signals through usage, adoption, and organizational change, and act thoughtfully and decisively.

  • Continuously refine sales strategies and execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated success in software sales, typically gained through 4+ years of experience in quota-carrying roles focused on customer growth and expansion (years of experience can be flexible based on impact and performance).

  • Experience in B2B software sales, with exposure to commercial, mid-market, or growth-focused roles.

  • Demonstrated ability to sell to technical audiences and learn complex products quickly

  • Experience managing and expanding existing customer accounts through value-based selling.

  • Strong discovery skills and comfort navigating both technical and business conversations.

  • Ability to prioritize effectively across a portfolio of accounts with varying levels of opportunity and complexity.

  • Solid track record of meeting or exceeding revenue goals.

  • Collaborative mindset and experience working cross-functionally with technical and customer-facing teams.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a high degree of ownership.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to adapt to different personas.

  • Curiosity, coachability, and a genuine interest in growing into more complex sales environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or platform technologies.

  • Exposure to consumption-based or usage-driven sales models.

  • Experience supporting expansion motions in SaaS or technical products.

  • Interest in progressing toward enterprise-level selling over time.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Architect - West
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Join our Technical Services team as a Senior Platform Architect and drive transformational outcomes with Temporal. You’ll be the accountable technical owner from purchase to stable production, turning complex challenges into scalable, repeatable solutions. Shape delivery patterns, operational standards, and enablement strategies that accelerate customer success and create lasting competitive advantage across teams and environments.

Location: Must reside in the Western Time Zone.

What You'll Do

Own Production Readiness and Activation

  • Act as the single owner of customers' scale-proof production readiness

  • Drive the first production workflow and reduce time-to-production

  • Establish guardrails and best practices for reliability, failure handling, scaling, and upgrades

  • Make developers Temporal SDK experts, make customer platform architects Temporal Server and SDK best practice experts

  • Set up alerting to catch issues before customers do

  • Work on your assigned customers' most difficult tickets and problems

  • Identify and remove activation blockers early before they become escalations

  • Optimize costs and performance with customers

Run the Customer's Technical Program

  • Build and execute a KPI-driven success plan tied to production outcomes

  • Define standards for patterns, training, governance, and operational readiness

  • Lead cross-functional coordination of Professional Services, Support, Partners, and internal teams, leveraging project management to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery

  • Proactively manage technical risk, migrations, and architectural debt

Ensure Long-Term Technical Health

  • Set and validate reliability, observability, and operational standards

  • Monitor health signals and intervene before the customer knows they're happening

  • Lead technical reviews, readiness checkpoints, and maturity assessments

  • Certify teams and workloads as production-ready

Drive Adoption Through Production Success

  • Surface growth signals based on usage, maturity, and confidence

  • Partner with customers, Growth AEs and Solution Architects to unlock new workloads

  • Translate production success into clear technical narratives for renewal and growth

  • Advocate for customer needs and real-world patterns internally

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering or solutions engineering experience

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, workflow orchestration, and reliability engineering principles

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Go, Java, TypeScript, or Python

  • Experience building, deploying, and operating production systems at scale

  • Demonstrated ability to debug complex technical issues and guide customers through resolution

  • Strong customer-facing skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences

  • Experience creating technical documentation, runbooks, and training materials

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while collaborating across teams

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements and team events

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with Temporal or similar workflow orchestration platforms

  • Experience with observability tools and practices for distributed systems

  • Background in professional services, technical consulting, or solutions engineering roles

  • Experience with Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and infrastructure-as-code tools

  • Contributions to open source projects or developer communities

jobs.title: Director, Global Developer Success
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal is hiring a Director, Global Developer Success to lead and scale our deeply technical support organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for turning customer technical response into a repeatable, measurable, and differentiated advantage for Temporal.

Developer Success is the team customers rely on when they need fast, confident support for complex developer and infrastructure issues. The team helps users deploy, operate, debug, and scale Temporal across cloud-native environments, distributed systems, SDKs, observability stacks, and mission-critical workloads. The next phase requires a leader who can preserve technical excellence and customer empathy while building the operational rigor of a world-class support function.

Why This Role Exists

Temporal's customers are building increasingly mission-critical, distributed, long-running, and AI-enabled systems. When something is unclear or broken, the support experience must be fast, technically credible, and predictable.

  • Developer Success must scale beyond heroics. We need clear KPIs, tiering, queue management, escalation paths, incident communication standards, RCA practices, quality review, and talent development systems.

  • Premium customer interactions increasingly happen across tickets, Slack, escalations, and incident channels. The support experience must have one clear operating model so customers, Sales, SAs, Platform Architects, Product, Engineering, and Support know who owns what and what good looks like.

  • The support team must reduce avoidable Engineering escalations while ensuring real product defects, documentation gaps, and recurring customer pain reach Product and Engineering with high-quality signal.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead Global Developer Success: Hire, coach, develop, retain, and performance-manage high-performing support engineers, managers, and specialists across tiers, regions, and customer segments.

  • Create the support operating system: Define SLAs/OLAs, ticket and Slack triage, queue ownership, severity definitions, tiering, escalation paths, incident communications, RCA standards, quality review, staffing, and operating cadence.

  • Raise the quality bar: Move beyond CSAT alone by measuring customer effort, touches to resolution, reopen rate, handoffs, recurrence, communication quality, resolution confidence, and customer-visible ownership.

  • Harden Slack and customer response: Turn premium Slack response into a defined service model with acknowledgement standards, urgent paths, conversion-to-ticket rules, coverage model, manager review, and customer-facing expectations.

  • Protect Engineering focus through better support: Reduce avoidable escalations by building runbooks, diagnostics, knowledge systems, reproducibility standards, technical triage, and high-quality escalation packets.

  • Lead escalation and incident discipline: Establish crisp roles for technical lead, escalation manager, communications owner, Support, Engineering, SA, Platform Architecture, and Sales. Ensure incidents and critical escalations are communicated with clarity and followed by useful RCAs.

  • Build technical depth and enablement: Create career paths, training, mentorship, certification, quality review, and hands-on learning that help junior engineers become senior/staff support engineers and help senior engineers scale their expertise.

  • Partner across the company: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Architecture, Platform Architecture, Customer Success, Docs, DevRel, and Services to ensure support signal turns into product, documentation, enablement, and customer lifecycle improvements.

  • Use tooling and AI pragmatically: Improve routing, deflection, summaries, analytics, knowledge surfacing, diagnostics, and customer communication while measuring real operating outcomes rather than tool adoption alone.

  • Represent Temporal with customers: Engage directly in strategic escalations, high-stakes incidents, enterprise support conversations, QBR/EBR inputs, and executive readouts when support experience affects customer trust.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience in technical support, customer engineering, SRE, solutions engineering, infrastructure engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles, with 5+ years leading support or customer-facing engineering teams.

  • Proven experience building and scaling technical support operations for a deeply technical B2B product, ideally in developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, observability, AI infrastructure, open source, or distributed systems within a GTM organization.

  • Experience managing managers and building the systems that make teams run: metrics, operating cadence, queue management, quality review, staffing models, tiering, escalation paths, and performance management.

  • Strong technical credibility with developers, support engineers, SREs, platform engineers, and product engineers. You can reason about APIs/SDKs, cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, observability, distributed systems, reliability, incident response, and debugging workflows.

  • Track record reducing avoidable Engineering escalations while improving the quality of product and engineering signal when escalations are needed.

  • Deep understanding of support quality metrics: response time, resolution time, customer effort, touches, reopens, recurrence, backlog, SLA/OLA attainment, deflection, CSAT, sentiment, and case quality.

  • Strong customer communication skills in high-pressure situations. You can write crisp updates, lead customer-facing RCA conversations, set expectations, and coach others to communicate clearly.

  • Clear philosophy for hiring, onboarding, leveling, progression, coaching, retention, and performance management for technical support engineers and support managers.

  • High ownership and builder mindset. You create clarity in ambiguous systems, ship v1 processes quickly, and iterate with data and customer evidence.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Temporal, Cadence, workflow engines, orchestration systems, event-driven architecture, distributed applications, or production reliability tooling.

  • Experience in consumption-based, open-source, developer-led, or mission-critical enterprise support motions.

  • Energized by working within a GTM organization.

  • Experience with support tooling and modern AI support systems such as Pylon, Zendesk, Kapa-like deflection, knowledge automation, case analytics, or incident communications tooling.

  • Hands-on background with Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Terraform, Go, Java, Python, TypeScript, or similar technologies.

  • Experience building Tier 3 / elite support, OSS/community support, self-hosted support, premium support, or 24/7 critical escalation coverage.

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

jobs.title: Senior Professional Services Engineer - East
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal customers are building some of the most critical, reliability-sensitive systems in production. They choose Temporal to move faster, ship with confidence, and operate durable workflows at scale.

As a Senior Professional Services Engineer, you will help customers and partners move from design to production-ready execution quickly and safely. You will establish strong delivery patterns, operational standards, and enablement that scale across teams and environments (cloud and self-hosted). This is a delivery-focused role centered on making systems work in the real world, and leaving customers better equipped than when you arrived.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver production-ready Temporal implementations by co-building initial workflows with customer and partner engineering teams

  • Implement and teach production-safe workflow patterns, including retries, timeouts, heartbeats, determinism, and versioning

  • Identify and remove early activation blockers before they become escalations

  • Help customers stand up and operate Temporal Server in production, including self-hosted environments

  • Define worker deployment, scaling, and operational guardrails, including upgrade strategy, failure handling, and capacity planning

  • Establish observability and reliability standards by defining metrics, alerts, and dashboards for workflows, workers, and Temporal Server

  • Create repeatable runbooks, templates, examples, and documentation that improve delivery quality across engagements

  • Lead hands-on workshops and training that enable customer and partner engineers to operate safely and independently

  • Own complex technical delivery issues end-to-end, partnering with Support and Platform Architects to reduce escalations to Engineering

  • Provide actionable product and engineering feedback based on real-world implementation patterns and failure modes

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience delivering and operating production systems where reliability and incident response matter

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, failure modes, scaling tradeoffs, and operational safety

  • Hands-on coding ability in at least one major language such as Go, Java, Python, or TypeScript

  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud and or self-hosted environments

  • Ability to design and communicate operational standards, including on-call readiness, runbooks, and capacity planning

  • Comfort working directly with customers in high-stakes delivery moments, with a calm and credible approach

  • Strong debugging skills and ability to navigate ambiguity and messy real-world constraints

  • Ability to teach and enable other engineers, not just deliver the work directly

Nice to Have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration systems, distributed task processing, or durable execution concepts

  • A track record of building observability programs, including dashboards, alerting strategies, and operational maturity models

  • Proven ability to create reusable reference architectures, templates, or internal enablement programs

  • Strong partnership skills to collaborate with product and engineering teams and translate field learnings into roadmap improvements

  • Background in working with partners or services delivery models at scale

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Foundations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We have an opening for a Senior Software Infrastructure Engineer in our Infrastructure team focused on driving technical strategy, alignment and execution of projects across compute, networking, cloud orchestration, and observability. This is an opportunity to join an engineering team focused on improving the scalability and reliability of Temporal’s core infrastructure.

In this role, you will be the SME and build critical systems to identify and reduce costs as we optimize for scale in the cloud. 

 

What You'll Do

Invent

  • Build systems that optimize cloud use and scale for expansion.

  • Contribute to system architecture and execution.

  • Co-author roadmaps establishing the vision for infrastructure scalability, reliability, and engineering velocity.

  • Continue to maintain and foster a culture of engineering and operational excellence.

Own

  • Develop effective partnerships across engineering and product teams.

  • Collaborate across teams to keep roadmaps aligned.

  • Perform design reviews for multiple projects with a focus on infrastructure scalability and reliability.

  • Partner with Security to build ‘secure by default’ systems.

  • Engage with stakeholders and customers to help understand their requirements and enable their business.

Learn

  •  Investigate and understand the ways to best leverage Temporal’s own software to power infrastructure at scale.

  • Get educated as to Temporal's customer needs that drive infrastructure design decisions.

Collaborate

  • Share design principles for building reliable systems at scale.

  • Learn and help others get better while you grow.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience contributing to complex cross-team engineering efforts focused on cloud, compute, networking and storage infrastructure.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

  • You are comfortable driving alignment across an organization and contributing to long-term roadmaps.

  • Demonstrated ability to make system-level tradeoffs.

  • At least 10 years coding experience (Go, Java, or other applicable language) and experience writing concurrent code.

  • Experience designing distributed systems and using concurrency primitives.

  • Deep experience in at least one infrastructure and familiarity with adjacencies.

  • Hands-on experience with one or more cloud providers, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Traffic
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our Traffic team, where you will play a key role in driving the technical strategy, execution, and leadership of projects across traffic management, network optimization, and cloud orchestration. This is an exciting opportunity to significantly impact the scalability, reliability, and operational excellence of Temporal’s networking infrastructure, while also mentoring and guiding the team.

What You'll Do

Invent

  • Lead the design and development of systems that optimize network traffic and scale for global expansion.

  • Drive architectural decisions for high-impact projects, ensuring scalability and reliability.

  • Co-author long-term technical roadmaps that set the vision for network scalability, performance, and engineering velocity.

  • Set the standard for a culture of engineering and operational excellence.

Own

  • Build and nurture effective partnerships across engineering, product, and security teams to align on network infrastructure goals.

  • Lead and conduct design reviews for critical projects with a focus on system-level tradeoffs and network scalability.

  • Drive the design and implementation of “secure by default” network systems in collaboration with security teams.

  • Act as a key stakeholder by engaging with customers and internal teams to understand business requirements and deliver innovative solutions.

Learn

  • Deeply understand how to leverage Temporal’s software to build and scale networking infrastructure.

  • Gather insights into customer needs and incorporate them into technical decision-making for traffic management and networking strategies.

  • Stay at the forefront of technology advancements in traffic management, networking, and cloud orchestration.

Collaborate

  • Mentor and guide engineers, sharing best practices and design principles for building reliable and scalable networking systems.

  • Drive alignment across teams, ensuring roadmaps are cohesive and deliverables are on track.

  • Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented environment, helping others improve while continuing to expand your own expertise.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience leading complex engineering efforts focused on network traffic management, network optimization, and cloud orchestration.

  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to align stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams.

  • A track record of contributing to long-term technical roadmaps and making thoughtful system-level tradeoffs.

  • At least 8+ years of coding experience in languages like Go, Java, or similar, with strong expertise in writing concurrent and distributed code.

  • Extensive experience designing and building distributed systems, leveraging concurrency primitives, and optimizing network performance.

  • Deep expertise in traffic and networking systems, with familiarity across adjacent infrastructure domains.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud providers such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and the ability to optimize cost, performance, and scalability.

  • A strong sense of ownership and the ability to balance short-term priorities with long-term strategic goals.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Corporate Controller
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We are a high-growth, private, consumption-based software company seeking a Vice President, Global Controller to build and lead our accounting, tax, treasury, and procurement functions. This is a rare opportunity for a hands-on financial leader to own the full accounting and operating infrastructure of a scaling business, partner closely with the CFO and executive team, and help architect the systems, controls, and international footprint needed to support the company's next phase of growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own all aspects of global accounting operations, including the monthly and quarterly close, consolidations, technical accounting (including usage-based/consumption revenue recognition under ASC 606), and financial reporting.

  • Lead corporate tax strategy and compliance, including domestic and international tax planning, transfer pricing, and indirect tax (sales/use, VAT/GST) as the company expands globally.

  • Build and manage treasury operations: cash management, banking relationships, FX exposure, and capital deployment across multiple currencies and entities.

  • Own global procurement and vendor management: source-to-pay processes, vendor contract negotiation, spend management, and purchasing policies/controls as the company scales.

  • Design and scale accounting infrastructure, systems, and processes (ERP, billing, and close automation) to support rapid consumption-based revenue growth.

  • Establish and maintain a strong internal control environment (SOX-ready), including policies, procedures, and audit readiness in anticipation of a future public offering or transaction.

  • Lead all aspects of the annual financial statement audit and manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and banking partners.

  • Guide international expansion from a finance and accounting perspective: entity structuring, local statutory and tax compliance, and building out finance operations in new markets.

  • Partner with the CFO and cross-functional leaders (Legal, Sales, Revenue Operations) on deal structuring, contract review, and revenue recognition for new consumption-based pricing models.

  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing global accounting and tax team as the organization grows.

  • Deliver accurate, timely financial reporting to executive leadership, the board of directors, and investors.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive accounting/finance experience, including significant leadership experience in a high-growth SaaS or consumption/usage-based software company for both private and public companies.

  • CPA required; Big 4 public accounting background strongly preferred.

  • Deep expertise in US GAAP, including ASC 606 revenue recognition for consumption/usage-based models.

  • Proven experience building or scaling tax and treasury functions, including international tax and multi-entity/multi-currency operations.

  • Track record of scaling accounting infrastructure and teams through periods of rapid growth, ideally including international expansion.

  • Experience preparing an organization for an IPO is strongly preferred.

  • Experience owning or partnering closely with procurement/vendor management, including contract negotiation and spend controls.

  • Strong systems acumen (e.g., NetSuite, Workday, or similar ERP; billing platforms for usage-based revenue).

  • Excellent communication and executive presence; able to partner directly with the CFO, CEO, board, and investors.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; MBA a plus.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our high-impact team focused on product scalability, customer experience, and revenue growth. Our team owns business-critical services including customer onboarding and off-boarding, billing and metering, cloud marketplace integrations, customer-facing usage and cost reporting, and the account data integrations that keep revenue systems in sync across the business.

In this role, you'll lead technical direction and build systems that directly impact Temporal's revenue engine and customer journey. You'll partner closely with engineers, product managers, finance, revenue operations, support, and sales to design resilient architectures, drive cross-functional execution, and raise the reliability and scalability bar for our billing, metering, and customer lifecycle platforms. If you enjoy owning ambiguous, high-leverage problems and building durable systems that scale with the business, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the Design of Business-Critical Systems: Own end-to-end technical design and delivery for services that power customer acquisition, onboarding/offboarding, and revenue operations.

  • Drive Architectural Excellence: Define and evolve system architecture for high-throughput, fault-tolerant metering and billing pipelines; make principled tradeoffs across correctness, latency, cost, and operability.

  • Own Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Finance, RevOps, and Sales to translate business needs into robust, scalable systems—anticipating edge cases, ensuring auditability, and aligning stakeholders on milestones and risks.

  • Own the Account Lifecycle End to End: Build the flows that carry an account from acquisition through activation, expansion, billing, and offboarding—self-service and operator-initiated onboarding, plan and SKU changes, suspension, dunning, and clean offboarding.

  • Keep Revenue Data Coherent Across the Business: Own the integrations and pipelines that reconcile control-plane state with CRM, support, analytics, and BI systems, so finance, support, and sales operate on the same numbers.

  • Build Customer-Facing Usage and Cost Transparency: Design the APIs and metrics surfaces customers use to understand their spend—usage APIs, cost reporting, and billable-action metrics—with the accuracy and latency guarantees that make them trustworthy.

  • Ensure Data Integrity, Reliability, and Compliance: Build and operate distributed data systems with strong correctness guarantees; implement monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks that keep revenue-impacting pipelines trustworthy.

  • Raise the Engineering Bar: Set quality standards through code reviews, design reviews, and operational readiness; introduce patterns and tooling that improve maintainability and incident response.

  • Mentor and Multiply Impact: Mentor engineers, unblock execution, and foster a culture of ownership, learning, and pragmatic excellence.

  • Improve Developer and Customer Experience: Identify opportunities to streamline customer flows via automation, better tooling, and targeted platform improvements that reduce friction and support load.

Technology Stack

  • Primary Language: Go

  • Data Storage: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redshift, S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage

  • Data Processing: Kinesis, Firehose

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes

  • Billing & Revenue: Metronome, Stripe

  • Go-to-Market Integrations: Salesforce, Segment, Pylon, Zapier, cloud marketplace APIs

  • Customer-Facing Standards: OpenMetrics, FOCUS

  • Core Framework: Temporal (of course 😉)

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience designing and delivering production-grade backend systems (ideally in cloud environments) with meaningful ownership over architecture and operational outcomes.

  • Strong proficiency in at least one systems/backend language (Go preferred), with the ability to navigate large codebases and drive technical decisions.

  • Demonstrated experience building and operating distributed systems: concurrency, reliability, scaling, consistency, and failure handling.

  • Practical understanding of data pipelines and storage systems (e.g., Postgres, Redshift, Kafka/Kinesis, S3-like systems) and how to ensure correctness and traceability.

  • Experience integrating and reconciling against third-party SaaS platforms (billing, CRM, support, analytics), including idempotency, drift detection, and recovery when an upstream system disagrees with your source of truth.

  • Experience with production operations: observability, incident response, performance tuning, on-call readiness, and continuous delivery.

  • Ability to work effectively across functions (Finance/RevOps/Sales/Support), translating ambiguous requirements into clear, executable technical plans.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write design docs, align stakeholders, and explain tradeoffs.

  • A "builder" mindset: you enjoy simplifying complex workflows, improving tooling, and leaving systems better than you found them.

What You Can Expect

  • High-impact ownership over systems tied directly to revenue, customer lifecycle, and platform scalability

  • Collaborative engineering culture focused on quality, pragmatism, and measurable outcomes

  • Exceptional technical colleagues and a feedback-rich environment

  • Lean processes and autonomy without unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Strong emphasis on reliability and operational excellence—balanced with rapid iteration

  • A team that values mentorship, thoughtful design, and steady improvements that compound over time

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Role Summary

The Senior Solutions Architect is Temporal's primary customer-facing technical leader within Singapore, focusing on the APJ region. In this crucial role, you’ll work directly with prospects and customers, guiding them in understanding the suitability of their applications for Temporal’s platform and showcasing the technical advantages of our cloud service. Your contribution is vital in positioning Temporal against alternative technologies, helping customer engineering teams expand production applications using Temporal, and owning the technical relationship with key decision-makers. Your role is integral to our success.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with prospects to determine if their applications fit Temporal’s platform well.

  • Educate customers and prospects on the technical benefits and limitations of Temporal’s platform and cloud service.

  • Position Temporal as a leading solution against competing technologies and architectural patterns.

  • Foster an environment within customer engineering organizations to increase Temporal adoption and expansion in production environments.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to develop and execute comprehensive account plans.

  • Manage and nurture relationships with technical decision-makers at customer organizations to ensure they fully leverage Temporal’s capabilities.

What You’ll Bring

  • Reside in Singapore and are eligible to work without sponsorship.

  • Exceptional technical communication skills, including presenting, whiteboarding, and writing.

  • Deep understanding of distributed system technologies, design principles, and best practices.

  • Proficiency in building application prototypes and providing design, development, build, and deployment guidance using one or more of Temporal’s supported languages: Java, Golang, TypeScript, Python, C# or PHP.

  • Firm grasp of operational considerations in production environments, such as security, reliability, performance, cost management, and operations.

  • Ability to provide insightful advice on architectural topics, including application patterns and platform architectures.

  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider and familiarity with commonly used application development and production services.

  • Serve as a strategic technical advisor to Sales Account Executives, assisting with scoping and sizing opportunities and offering guidance on technical fit and challenges.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Sponsorship & Experiential
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal has made a landmark investment as the front-of-shirt sponsor for Crystal Palace FC in the Premier League. This role is for a field marketer and campaign leader first—someone who can turn the sponsorship into a repeatable engine for UK awareness, customer/prospect engagement, and pipeline influence, with a particular focus on getting the right accounts and buying committees “in the seats” through hospitality and integrated field programs.

We’re looking for an experienced field marketer with sports sponsorship and experiential marketing experience, ideally from a larger technical/technology company (or with clearly transferable experience), who understands how to build campaigns that align tightly with Sales priorities and resonate with technical and developer audiences across London and the broader UK market.

Location:

  • London strongly preferred.

  • Candidates based within the United States can also be considered if they have strong connections to the London/UK developer community and are comfortable building local partnerships and delivering in-person activations.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead integrated field marketing plans for the Crystal Palace sponsorship in the UK, translating business goals into campaigns that drive awareness, demand creation, and account engagement.

  • Partner tightly with Sales (most important):

    • Build strong operating rhythms with Sales leadership and account teams (planning, prioritization, follow-up, and measurement).

    • Proactively identify what Sales needs from Marketing to generate engagement and pipeline, and turn that into executable field programs.

    • Design account-driven experiences that help get the right customers and prospects into hospitality moments, events, and matchday experiences (and convert that engagement into next steps).

  • Bring the Crystal Palace sponsorship to life through engaging field marketing experiences:

    • Build a season-long activation approach that supports account engagement, executive relationships, and pipeline influence. We are looking for more than just brand impressions.

    • Develop “in-seat” engagement plays (target account invites, curated hospitality experiences, executive hosting moments, post-match follow-up motions).

  • Grow awareness with technical and developer audiences in the UK:

    • Create/scale programs that build Temporal’s presence with developers and technical communities in London and across the UK.

    • Partner with DevRel and local community leaders (and/or tap existing relationships) to create credible, high-signal experiences.

  • Own the partnership execution with Crystal Palace (secondary to field outcomes):

    • Run operating cadences (weekly check-ins in-season, planning meetings, pre/post-event reviews).

    • Coordinate rights inventory planning and utilization (player/talent access, matchday assets, content moments, community initiatives).

    • Manage approvals, timelines, and deliverables; ensure contractual expectations are met.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally to fully integrate programs (content, PR, paid, lifecycle/email, social, SDR/BDR follow-up, partner channels).

  • Own vendor/agency execution (experiential, production, creative, event partners) with high quality, strong operational rigor, and budget discipline.

  • Measure impact and tell the performance story:

    • Define success metrics (pipeline influence where measurable; directional impact where not).

    • Produce clear recaps and recommendations to improve outcomes throughout the season.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong field marketing and campaign leadership experience, ideally in a technical/technology company, with a track record of delivering integrated programs that support revenue goals.

  • Proven ability to partner with and influence Sales, including comfort aligning priorities, driving joint planning, and building follow-up motions that convert engagement into pipeline.

  • Experience leveraging events, hospitality, and experiential marketing to create meaningful account engagement, attract priority audiences, and inspire continued connection.

  • Experience marketing to technical and developer audiences (developer platforms, infrastructure, tools, or similarly technical products preferred).

  • Sponsorship and experiential experience (sports sponsorship strongly preferred), with comfort managing complex partnerships, rights packages, and high-visibility activations.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership: able to align stakeholders, run tight processes, and execute in fast-moving environments.

  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal): comfortable presenting plans, recaps, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing a major sports sponsorship within a large technology company.

  • DevRel exposure and/or existing connections in the London / UK developer community.

  • Premiere League sponsorship experience (helpful, but should not outweigh field marketing strength, Sales partnership ability, and technical audience experience).

  • Highly organized and outcomes-focused; able to run multiple programs in parallel without losing detail.

  • Collaborative and low-ego; effective at influencing without authority and aligning cross-functional teams.

  • Strong taste and production instincts for high-visibility experiences.

  • Comfortable operating with imperfect attribution and able to define success, learn quickly, and iterate.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Summary

Are you eager to launch your sales career in a fast-growing, innovative tech company? Temporal is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to join our team in London, England. As a BDR, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving growth by connecting with potential customers, generating leads, and building strong pipelines for our sales team. 

This is an entry level role designed for ambitious self-starters who are passionate about technology, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are excited to develop their careers in sales. With a dedicated training program and clear growth path, you’ll have the support and tools to become a standout sales professional while contributing to Temporal’s mission of redefining application development.

What You'll Do

  • Proactively outbound prospecting and lead activity management in an effort to qualify and market Temporal to potential customers.

  • Discover opportunities from leads and set appointments from those leads. 

  • Use of strong selling and influencing skills to set up qualified appointments. 

  • Understand the Temporal OSS and Cloud solutions enough to provide high level introduction. 

  • Leverage taught sales techniques to maximize customer interactions. 

  • Log, track, and maintain outbound activity. 

  • Work closely with the Sales Team and attend customer meetings as required. 

  • Be the architect of a growing team, defining and iterating on processes.

What You'll Need

  • 1 to 2+ years of experience in prospecting roles.

  • Excellent in-person, phone, and written customer communication skills.

  • Must be able to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization.

  • Ability to make formal and informal presentations to staff and clients.

  • Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift work efforts based on the needs of the department or business goals.

jobs.title: Sales Manager (India)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We are seeking a collaborative and strategic Country Sales Manager, India to join our growing Temporal team. This role is ideal for a sales leader who enjoys building customer relationships, developing teams, and expanding a business within a high-growth technology company. This role includes leading and supporting a team of Account Executives, partnering closely with customers and strategic partners, and helping shape Temporal's go-to-market strategy across India. Travel is required to engage with customers, partners, attend industry events, and collaborate in person with internal teams.

You will play a key role in establishing and growing Temporal's business across India. As the Country Sales Manager, you will help define the regional sales strategy, support the growth and development of the sales organization, build lasting customer and partner relationships, and collaborate across Product, Marketing, Solutions Architecture, Developer Success, and Partnerships to expand adoption of Temporal OSS and Cloud. You will also represent Temporal within the India technology ecosystem, helping strengthen our presence with enterprise customers, partners, and the broader developer community.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute the sales strategy for India, supporting new customer acquisition and long-term growth across enterprise accounts.

  • Identify, qualify, and close strategic enterprise opportunities while building a sustainable pipeline across the region.

  • Engage customers and prospects through executive meetings, regional events, industry conferences, and on-site engagements to strengthen relationships and support successful business outcomes.

  • Navigate complex enterprise sales cycles involving technical and executive stakeholders across large organizations.

  • Partner with Marketing, Sales Development, Solutions Architecture, Developer Success, Customer Success, and Partnerships to deliver coordinated go-to-market initiatives.

  • Share market insights and customer feedback with Product and Go-to-Market teams to help inform product direction, regional priorities, and customer experience.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives, fostering an environment of collaboration, learning, and continuous professional growth.

  • Develop a deep understanding of customer technical environments, business priorities, and market trends across India.

  • Tailor Temporal's value proposition to technical and executive audiences, helping customers solve complex distributed systems challenges.

  • Use CRM and sales tools to manage opportunities, maintain accurate forecasts, and support effective sales execution.

  • Represent Temporal by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers, strategic partners, cloud providers, system integrators, and the broader developer community.

  • Partner with APAC leadership to help shape regional business strategy, territory planning, forecasting, and long-term growth initiatives.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years of enterprise technology or developer tools sales experience, including experience leading enterprise sales teams within India.

  • Experience developing and executing regional go-to-market strategies within a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience building or expanding a regional business, including developing customer relationships, supporting team growth, and identifying new market opportunities.

  • Demonstrated success growing enterprise business and closing complex six- and seven-figure opportunities.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software buying cycles, technical evaluation processes, and competitive landscapes.

  • Experience selling developer-focused, cloud infrastructure, open-source, AI, or other highly technical products is a plus.

  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing enterprise sales professionals.

  • Experience working with cloud providers, system integrators, channel partners, or broader technology ecosystems.

  • Ability to build trusted relationships with customers and influence stakeholders at all levels, from developers and architects to executive leadership.

  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and collaboration skills.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to balance strategic planning and execution.

  • Ability to understand and communicate technical concepts related to distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and modern software development.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gong, LinkedIn Navigator, Common Room, ZoomInfo, and other modern sales technologies.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Test Systems & Tooling
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal’s reliability is fundamental to why customers choose us—and as our customers run increasingly critical workloads on the platform, our ability to confidently test changes must scale with that responsibility.

As a Senior Engineering Manager on the Test Systems & Tooling team, you will lead a team responsible for building the shared systems, environments, and tooling that enable Temporal engineers to validate the platform under production-like and adverse conditions. You’ll help ensure system-level testing gaps don’t fall through organizational boundaries by driving cross-team alignment, clear ownership, and measurable improvements in pre-production confidence.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and grow the Test Systems & Tooling team: Hire, coach, and develop engineers building shared testing capabilities used across Engineering.

  • Make production-like testing practical: Improve the ability for engineers to create test environments that resemble production topology, configuration, scale, and behavior—so reproducing issues and validating changes is faster and more reliable.

  • Enable production-representative workload testing: Build or evolve capabilities such as workload replay, realistic workload generation, multi-tenant testing, load testing, and stress testing to surface behaviors that only emerge at scale.

  • Drive failure-mode validation: Establish repeatable ways to test Temporal through real failure conditions (e.g., dependency failures, latency injection, resource exhaustion, degraded-state recovery, and regional failure scenarios).

  • Create shared frameworks and guidance: Provide opinionated testing frameworks, patterns, and tooling that make it easier for product teams to write high-quality tests consistently, with visibility into test health and systemic gaps.

  • Own system-level coverage outcomes: Identify critical system-level scenarios that need explicit coverage, drive them to completion (often through partner teams), and ensure they’re integrated into continuous and/or release validation.

  • Collaborate across org boundaries: Partner closely with Cloud/Infrastructure, Reliability, Release Engineering, and product teams to turn production learnings into stronger pre-production detection.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience managing and developing a high-performing engineering team (including direct reports), with strong coaching, feedback, and performance management skills.

  • Strong technical background building or operating reliable distributed systems (or adjacent platform infrastructure) and the judgment to prioritize the failure modes that matter most.

  • Track record delivering internal platforms/tooling adopted by many teams—balancing ergonomics, speed, and long-term maintainability.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces where success depends on aligning stakeholders, clarifying ownership, and driving execution across multiple teams.

  • Ability to define and drive measurable outcomes (adoption, confidence signals, reduced escaped issues, faster incident-to-coverage time), not just ship tooling.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale testing practices: chaos engineering, fault injection, workload replay/shadowing, performance testing, or multi-tenant test strategy.

  • Experience partnering with Release Engineering or CI/CD platform teams to institutionalize validations in pipelines.

  • Familiarity with observability and incident response practices, and translating incident learnings into preventative test coverage.

ROLE SUMMARY

Temporal’s reliability is fundamental to why customers choose us—and as our customers run increasingly critical workloads on the platform, our ability to confidently test changes must scale with that responsibility.

As a Senior Engineering Manager on the Test Systems & Tooling team, you will lead a team responsible for building the shared systems, environments, and tooling that enable Temporal engineers to validate the platform under production-like and adverse conditions. You’ll help ensure system-level testing gaps don’t fall through organizational boundaries by driving cross-team alignment, clear ownership, and measurable improvements in pre-production confidence.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and grow the Test Systems & Tooling team: Hire, coach, and develop engineers building shared testing capabilities used across Engineering.

 - Make production-like testing practical: Improve the ability for engineers to create test environments that resemble production topology, configuration, scale, and behavior—so reproducing issues and validating changes is faster and more reliable.

 - Enable production-representative workload testing: Build or evolve capabilities such as workload replay, realistic workload generation, multi-tenant testing, load testing, and stress testing to surface behaviors that only emerge at scale.

 - Drive failure-mode validation: Establish repeatable ways to test Temporal through real failure conditions (e.g., dependency failures, latency injection, resource exhaustion, degraded-state recovery, and regional failure scenarios).

 - Create shared frameworks and guidance: Provide opinionated testing frameworks, patterns, and tooling that make it easier for product teams to write high-quality tests consistently, with visibility into test health and systemic gaps.

 - Own system-level coverage outcomes: Identify critical system-level scenarios that need explicit coverage, drive them to completion (often through partner teams), and ensure they’re integrated into continuous and/or release validation.

 - Collaborate across org boundaries: Partner closely with Cloud/Infrastructure, Reliability, Release Engineering, and product teams to turn production learnings into stronger pre-production detection.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience managing and developing a high-performing engineering team (including direct reports), with strong coaching, feedback, and performance management skills.

 - Strong technical background building or operating reliable distributed systems (or adjacent platform infrastructure) and the judgment to prioritize the failure modes that matter most.

 - Track record delivering internal platforms/tooling adopted by many teams—balancing ergonomics, speed, and long-term maintainability.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces where success depends on aligning stakeholders, clarifying ownership, and driving execution across multiple teams.

 - Ability to define and drive measurable outcomes (adoption, confidence signals, reduced escaped issues, faster incident-to-coverage time), not just ship tooling.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with large-scale testing practices: chaos engineering, fault injection, workload replay/shadowing, performance testing, or multi-tenant test strategy.

 - Experience partnering with Release Engineering or CI/CD platform teams to institutionalize validations in pipelines.

 - Familiarity with observability and incident response practices, and translating incident learnings into preventative test coverage.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Test Systems & Tooling
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal’s reliability is foundational to our value proposition, and as more customers run mission-critical workloads on Temporal, we need the ability to validate changes under production-like conditions and realistic failure modes before they reach production.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Test Systems & Tooling team, you will lead technical initiatives that make sophisticated system-level testing practical across Engineering—spanning production-representative environments, workload replay/generation, and repeatable failure-mode testing. You’ll build platforms and tooling that enable teams to reproduce and prevent the kinds of issues that only emerge from complex interactions between workload, scale, configuration, and multi-tenant behavior.

What You'll Do

  • Build production-like test environments: Design and evolve tooling that makes it easy for engineers to spin up test cells that resemble production topology, configuration, and behavior, in partnership with Cloud/Infrastructure.

  • Enable production-representative workloads: Build capabilities for workload generation, multi-tenant testing, stress/load testing, and (where appropriate) traffic replay or replay-like systems to reproduce production behaviors in controlled environments.

  • Make failure-mode testing repeatable: Create tooling for injecting and validating failure conditions (latency, dependency faults, resource exhaustion, degraded-state recovery, and region-level failure scenarios) so we test them deliberately—not just learn from production.

  • Drive system-level test coverage: Identify high-impact system-level scenarios that are currently hard to test, and implement (or partner with the right teams to implement) repeatable coverage that’s incorporated into continuous and/or release validation.

  • Build shared frameworks and paved paths: Provide opinionated libraries, harnesses, and patterns that make it easier for product teams to write high-quality system and integration tests consistently.

  • Raise the technical bar through leadership: Mentor engineers and influence testing strategy across the org through design docs, code reviews, and cross-team collaboration.

  • Partner across Engineering: Work closely with Reliability and Release Engineering to turn incident learnings into durable pre-production test coverage and to integrate validations into the release pipeline.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building and operating production-quality systems (platforms, infrastructure, developer tooling, or distributed systems).

  • Demonstrated technical leadership: leading ambiguous, cross-team initiatives; driving alignment; and delivering durable systems that other teams rely on.

  • Experience designing for observability, debuggability, and operational readiness (metrics, logs, tracing, safe rollouts, and failure analysis).

  • Comfort working across organizational boundaries—collaborating with Cloud/Infrastructure, Reliability, Release Engineering, and product teams to land outcomes.

  • Strong written communication skills (design docs, testing strategy proposals, and documentation that scales adoption).

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with chaos engineering, fault injection, workload replay/shadowing, performance testing, or multi-tenant test strategy.

  • Experience building internal platforms used broadly across an engineering org (paved roads, self-serve environments, shared frameworks).

  • Familiarity with measuring engineering/system outcomes (e.g., signal quality, coverage gaps closed, incident-to-coverage time, adoption).

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager,  Cloud Namespace & Capacity
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal Cloud is Temporal’s managed SaaS product, used by customers to run workloads with varying requirements for throughput, latency, resilience, isolation, data residency, and cost. Namespaces are the primary unit of isolation within Temporal Cloud.

In this role you’ll own the Cloud Namespace product surface end-to-end: ensuring customers can provision, configure, operate, and evolve Namespaces safely and effectively over time. You’ll partner with engineering teams to deliver customer-facing capabilities and shape internal operational systems for namespace placement, provisioning, capacity management, and more.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full Cloud Namespace lifecycle for an operator using Temporal Cloud: understanding workload needs, provisioning and management flows, defining the right configuration defaults and policies, updates-in-place, and safe deletion.

  • Define and evolve differentiated Namespace offerings (e.g., higher/lower SLA, latency, durability, residency, and cost options) that are easy for customers to understand and trust.

  • Own throughput and capacity management for Namespaces (e.g., autoscaling, TRUs, reserved vs. elastic capacity, scheduling, visibility, limits, and quotas).

  • Drive operational policy and features (Namespace placement in deployment rings, replication, scaling) to deliver highly performant, reliable, and cost-effective service at massive multi-tenant scale.

  • Define and own Namespace SLOs and SLAs, including instrumentation and customer-facing communication of performance and reliability expectations.

  • Own the Namespace APIs & configuration used by customer automation, the Temporal Cloud UI, and other products and services.

What You’ll Bring

  • Product leadership experience shipping and operating platform/infrastructure products, especially where reliability, performance, and cost tradeoffs matter.

  • Strong systems thinking: ability to translate workload needs into tiering, pricing, policy, quotas/limits, and defaults that scale across many customers.

  • Comfort partnering closely with engineering on technical topics like autoscaling, capacity planning, rolling deployment and placement logic, and resilience patterns—even if you’re not writing production code.

  • Experience defining and managing SLOs/SLAs and using metrics to drive product decisions and prioritization.

  • Ability to build alignment across stakeholders (Engineering, Cloud Ops/SRE, Support, Sales, Solutions, Security) and make clear, durable decisions in ambiguous environments.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to produce crisp PRDs, decision docs, and customer-facing explanations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with multi-tenant systems, workload isolation, and “noisy neighbor” mitigation.

  • Familiarity with API product design for long-lived resource lifecycle operations and safe evolution over time.

  • Background working on placement, routing, data residency, or geo-distributed reliability problems.

  • Experience building pricing/packaging inputs for tiered services in partnership with Finance/GTM.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Majors - West
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Temporal is a paradigm shift in modern application development, and one of the fastest developer movements in recent memory. We recently raised our $550M Series E to power the future of durable applications, and have become the orchestrator of choice for production agentic workloads.

In this role, you will own key accounts, navigate complex organizations and sell to highly technical stakeholders. You will lead with our hybrid value proposition, helping customers adopt both Temporal Cloud and self-hosted Temporal to meet their unique operational, regulatory, and performance requirements.

As a strategic partner to these organizations, your focus will be to guide them through adoption of Temporal as an enterprise-wide standard, leading with a services-first engagement model. You will work closely with our Resident Architects, partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver a unified enterprise experience that builds stakeholder trust and drives delivery against key business and technical objectives.

Come work with some of the brightest minds in the tech industry and help transform how modern applications are built. You will contribute to the growth of a category-defining company at the forefront of innovation.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage the entire sales lifecycle, from prospecting to close, with a focus on acquiring and expanding our presence within strategic accounts

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to land and expand within large enterprise organizations

  • Position Temporal as a mission-critical platform supporting high-performance, resilient workloads with strict SLA and uptime requirements

  • Engage with technical stakeholders to understand their operational needs and map Temporal solutions to their architecture and requirements

  • Navigate conversations around infrastructure, security, compliance, and performance across both SaaS and self-hosted environments

  • Drive enterprise adoption by aligning Temporal to business continuity, scalability, and developer productivity initiatives

  • Identify and expand high-value opportunities by embedding Temporal into the customer's platform and SDLC ecosystem

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a track record of selling technical platform solutions to engineers, architects, and executives

  • Experience navigating infrastructure and platforms in enterprise environments with a focus on positioning solutions to mission-critical use cases

  • Ability to sell services engagements, positioning enablement, certification, and long-term operational success as the foundation of a strategic partnership

  • Proven success closing deals within large, multi-stakeholder enterprise organizations with a track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets

  • Strong understanding of cloud, infrastructure, and developer tooling ecosystems

  • Comfort operating cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Legal and Solutions Architecture to support growth within key accounts

  • Familiarity with consumption-based pricing models and their implications for enterprise procurement

  • Outstanding communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for solving large-scale customer challenges in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
