jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing, GTM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal is building a category that is still new to much of the market. Buyers rarely begin with a feature or a defined budget. They begin with a critical process, a technical or business problem, and the tools they already know. Temporal must help them recognize the problem, understand where the product fits, and see why it matters now.

Working directly with the VP of Product Marketing, you will own market-facing Product Marketing. You will decide which customer problems, use cases, audiences, and industries deserve investment. You will own positioning and messaging, turn the strategy into campaigns and activation programs, set direction for solutions and sales plays, and co-own packaging of pricing with the VP. You will work across Demand Generation, Brand, Communications, Sales, and Solutions Architecture, bringing in Product Marketing Engineers when the work requires technical investigation or proof. You will own relationships with SIs.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write, make investment choices, shape programs, resolve recurring field needs, and advise the VP on GTM tradeoffs. You will manage a Solutions and Value Product Marketer and a Principal Competitive Intelligence Product Marketing Engineer. As the market changes, you will direct the team toward the customer and field problems that matter most.

What You Will Do

  • Set Temporal's market priorities across application and AI use cases, audiences, and selected industries. Decide where the company should focus, what outcome Temporal can credibly own, and what must be true for the investment to work.

  • Set the narrative, quality bar, and business priorities for solutions and vertical marketing. Ensure each solution connects technical architecture to developer, platform, operational, and business outcomes, then guide the Solutions and Value Product Marketer in turning those priorities into market programs and sales plays.

  • Turn the strategy into GTM plans across the company narrative, web, campaigns, content, events, field programs, and customer activation. Define the role of each channel and keep the story consistent from first exposure through adoption.

  • Run a disciplined intake and triage process for Sales and Solutions Architecture. Separate one-off requests from recurring market needs, then decide whether the response is positioning, content, competitive work, technical proof, product feedback, or a combination.

  • Co-own pricing and packaging with the VP of Product Marketing, partnering with Product, Finance, Sales, and Developer Success on customer evidence and market implications.

  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and the Product Marketing Engineers on major objections, new use cases, and strategic opportunities. Determine whether a recurring question requires a validated architecture pattern, a product change, a competitive answer, or reusable market guidance.

  • Turn the problem, decision, implementation, and results into proof for solutions, verticals, campaigns, and sales plays and into insight for Product, Engineering, and GTM strategy.

  • Set priorities for the Solutions and Value Product Marketer and the Principal Competitive Intelligence Product Marketing Engineer and Competitive Intel PMM . Hold the work to measurable outcomes and turn field and technical findings into decisions about positioning, product strategy, campaigns, and sales strategy.

jobs.title: Manager, GSI Partnerships
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal is a paradigm shift in modern application development, and one of the fastest developer movements in recent memory. Following our $300M Series D at a $5B valuation, we’re continuing to power the future of durable applications and have quickly become the orchestrator of choice for production agentic workloads. Global System Integrators are a core company bet and critical to establishing Temporal as trusted infrastructure for the world’s largest enterprises - building enterprise credibility, accelerating adoption across strategic workloads, and scaling Temporal through the firms that architect, build and modernize their most critical systems. As Manager, GSI Partnerships, you’ll own a focused set of strategic GSI relationships and build the full business model around them across sell with, sell to, and sell through.

This is a builder role for someone who combines alliance leadership with demonstrated enterprise-selling instincts. You’ll work across GSI executives, global alliance teams, practices, industry groups, and account teams to turn a small number of high-potential partnerships into meaningful sourced & influenced pipeline, consumption, and customer outcomes. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a core company bet from the ground floor, with high visibility and meaningful ownership over how Temporal builds enterprise credibility, accelerates adoption, and scales through the world’s leading GSIs.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow a focused portfolio of priority GSIs, building multi-year joint business plans and executive relationships that translate into measurable pipeline, consumption, and customer outcomes

  • Make Temporal strategically relevant inside each GSI by driving internal adoption, practitioner enablement, and, where appropriate, Temporal-powered managed services and repeatable offerings

  • Align Temporal sellers with GSI account, industry, and practice teams; map strategic accounts; source and shape joint opportunities; and orchestrate co-sell execution from account planning through close

  • Create repeatable routes for GSIs to resell, package, deliver, and operate Temporal as part of broader transformation programs and managed services

  • Develop high-leverage joint GTM and solution plays around priority use cases and industries, partnering with a Technical Services, Product, and Marketing to turn partner capabilities into repeatable offerings

  • Navigate large, matrixed GSI organizations to build executive sponsorship and activate the field, while serving as the internal voice of the partner across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success

  • Establish a rigorous operating cadence for each partnership, including pipeline inspection, joint account planning, enablement and practitioner goals, project delivery, and business reviews; operate as a force multiplier for Temporal sellers

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years in strategic partnerships, alliances, enterprise sales, and/or business development, including significant direct ownership of one or more top-tier GSI relationships and a track record of turning those relationships into sourcing engines

  • Proven experience building and executing sell-to, sell-with, and sell-through motions with large RSIs or GSIs, spanning internal adoption or managed offerings, field co-sell across strategic accounts, and resale or delivery motions

  • Demonstrated enterprise-selling instincts: you can identify opportunity, shape deals, mobilize account teams, inspect pipeline, and partner effectively with sales leadership to move complex opportunities forward

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, matrixed global organizations and build relationships from alliance leaders and practice executives to field sellers, account leaders, and delivery teams

 

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform Foundations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Summary

The Cloud Platform Foundations team builds and operates the core infrastructure behind Temporal Cloud, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and automation. The team owns foundational systems including high availability and disaster recovery, control plane automation, resource and namespace management, and the customer-facing interfaces that shape how users integrate with the platform—from our APIs and CLI to the Terraform provider, SDKs, and Kubernetes operator.

In this role, you'll build systems that directly strengthen Temporal Cloud's resilience, performance, and developer experience. You'll work closely with engineers and product managers to automate critical operations, evolve our multi-tenant control plane, reduce blast radius, improve namespace density, and build safer CI/CD pipelines. If you enjoy solving ambiguous, high-leverage infrastructure problems and creating durable tools that help both customers and engineers move faster, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • High Availability & Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) — Enabling continuous regional failover and improving platform resilience.

  • Control Plane Automation — Automating operations to improve reliability and developer efficiency.

  • Database Performance and Optimization: Our data layer is scaling beyond its current limits. We need someone who can scale it by orders of magnitude while holding the line on latency, reliability, and availability.

  • Deployment Plane: As our deploy frequency and engineering headcount both climb, we own redesigning the path from commit to production, drawing on strong infrastructure, deployment tooling, and systems design expertise.

  • CI/CD for Control Plane — Building reliable pipelines for safer rollouts, faster iteration, and better test coverage.

Technology Stack

  • Primary Language: Go

  • Data Storage: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redshift, S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage

  • Data Processing: Kinesis, Firehose

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes

  • Billing & Revenue: Metronome, Stripe

  • Go-to-Market Integrations: Salesforce, Segment, Pylon, Zapier, cloud marketplace APIs

  • Customer-Facing Standards: OpenMetrics, FOCUS

  • Core Framework: Temporal (of course 😉)

What You Can Expect

  • High-impact ownership over systems tied directly to revenue, customer lifecycle, and platform scalability

  • Collaborative engineering culture focused on quality, pragmatism, and measurable outcomes

  • Exceptional technical colleagues and a feedback-rich environment

  • Lean processes and autonomy without unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Strong emphasis on reliability and operational excellence—balanced with rapid iteration

  • A team that values mentorship, thoughtful design, and steady improvements that compound over time

What You'll Bring

  • Backend engineering experience with a cloud/infrastructure focus, ideally with some ops exposure — a blend of infra and database-driven systems.

  • Experience on a control plane team for cloud-based microservices.

  • Background building or operating multi-tenant SaaS applications.

  • Familiarity with density-oriented cloud provider architectures.

  • Strong Postgres (or similar relational database) experience.

  • Track record designing for high availability, and managing compute and traffic at scale.

  • Solid database chops, and a bias toward building rather than just configuring — you'd rather write the tool than click through one.

  • CLI and DevOps fluency.

  • Nice to Have - Exposure to data pipelining.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Architect, Majors - East
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Summary

The Solutions Architect is Temporal’s primary customer-facing technical leader within the Majors team (East). In this crucial role, you’ll work directly with prospects and customers, guiding them in understanding the suitability of their applications for Temporal’s platform and showcasing the technical advantages of our cloud service. Your contribution is vital in positioning Temporal against alternative technologies, helping customer engineering teams expand production applications using Temporal, and owning the technical relationship with key decision-makers. Your role is integral to our success.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with prospects to determine if their applications fit Temporal’s platform well.

  • Educate customers and prospects on the technical benefits and limitations of Temporal’s platform and cloud service.

  • Position Temporal as an enterprise development standard against competing technologies and architectural patterns.

  • Foster an environment within customer engineering organizations to increase the adoption and expansion of Temporal in production environments.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to develop and execute comprehensive account plans across both new opportunities and expansion, accounting for the customer's long-term success and outcome.

  • Manage and nurture relationships with technical decision-makers within customer organizations, ensuring they fully leverage Temporal’s capabilities.

  • Create reusable technical assets, reference architectures, playbooks, and demos that provides value for other Solution Architects.

  • Travel expected to be 25-50%

What You’ll Bring

  • Reside within the Eastern time zone (United States)

  • Exceptional technical communication skills across altitudes, from a staff-level engineer whiteboard to a platform-team enablement session to a VP/CTO narrative.

  • Deep understanding of distributed system technologies, design principles, and best practices.

  • Proficiency in building application prototypes and providing design, development, build, and deployment guidance using one or more of Temporal’s supported languages: Java, Golang, Python, C#, TypeScript, Ruby, or Rust.

  • Firm grasp of operational considerations in production environments, such as security, reliability, performance, cost management, and operations.

  • Ability to provide insightful advice on architectural topics, including application patterns and platform architectures.

  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider and familiarity with commonly used application development and production services.

  • Ability to serve as a strategic technical advisor to Sales Account Executives, assisting with scoping and sizing opportunities and offering guidance on technical fit and challenges.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Nexus
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager, Nexus to own the next phase of Temporal Nexus: landing the current product foundation, expanding adoption across strategic accounts, and defining the roadmap for Nexus as Temporal’s durable connectivity layer.

This person will take over an active, technically deep product area with real customer usage and a fast-moving roadmap. The immediate work is to land the in-flight Nexus developer experience and operator-control work with quality. The longer-term mandate is to shape the next wave: Connector Ecosystem, Service Hub, and Agentic Communication Fabric.

This is not a “write specs and wait” role. The PM will need to build trust quickly with engineering, customers, field teams, and GTM; understand the product hands-on; turn messy customer evidence into sequencing decisions; and create the narrative that helps Temporal, customers, and partners understand where Nexus is going.

What You’ll Own

  • Nexus product strategy and roadmap. Prioritize the work that makes Nexus the durable connectivity layer across teams, namespaces, services, and AI systems.

  • Current execution. Drive completion of in-flight work such as the new Nexus developer experience, Standalone Nexus Operations, connector foundations, caller identity, rate limits, and payload encryption.

  • Customer discovery and evidence. Stay close to design partners and strategic customers like Netflix, Duolingo, and Miro.

  • Developer and operator experience. Balance SDK ergonomics, schema-first contracts, codegen, service discovery, security, visibility, and control-plane needs.

  • Cross-functional launch and enablement. Make sure everyone in the company understands the problems Nexus solves and knows how to sell / deploy / support it.

  • Success metrics. Define adoption and momentum measures: activated accounts, completed Nexus operations, shared-service usage, SDK coverage, design-partner progress, and field readiness.

What You’ll Bring

  • Staff-level product judgment. 8+ years in product management or equivalent experience turning ambiguous and technical strategy into shipped outcomes.

  • Strong technical depth. Ability to reason about distributed systems, workflow orchestration, service-to-service communication, APIs, SDKs, identity, and authorization.

  • Developer-platform experience. Experience with infrastructure, platforms, integrations, APIs, SDKs, service mesh, API gateways, or cloud developer products.

  • Customer and field orientation. Comfortable working directly with senior technical customers and enabling GTM teams on a complex product.

  • Excellent writing and narrative skills. Able to create crisp strategy docs, roadmap narratives, launch materials, and decision memos.

  • Execution discipline. Can inherit a complicated roadmap, clarify ownership, unblock decisions, and keep the team focused.

Who You Are

  • You want to build important infrastructure. You’re motivated by products that sit in the critical path for customers and developers. You want to work on something foundational, technically deep, and category-defining.

  • You operate with ownership. You don’t measure your job by meetings, specs, or process completed. You measure it by customer outcomes, product adoption, team clarity, and whether the right work actually ships.

  • You move fast without being reckless. Nexus sits in the reliability layer for mission-critical systems. You know when to push for speed, when to insist on rigor, and how to keep momentum without compromising customer trust.

  • You’re resilient in ambiguity. You’re energized by unclear ownership, messy customer evidence, technical constraints, and hard sequencing calls. You don’t need a perfect roadmap handed to you — you help create one.

  • You raise the bar for the people around you. You write clearly, invite feedback, give it directly, and help teams make better decisions. You make complex work easier for others to understand and execute.

  • You put developers and customers first. You want to understand how real teams build distributed systems, where their current tools fail them, and what would make Temporal indispensable in their architecture.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Temporal, workflow orchestration, durable execution, service mesh, API gateways, or distributed systems

  • Experience with schema registries, code generation, SDK design, or developer portals

  • Experience with AI infrastructure, agent platforms, MCP/tool registries, or agentic systems

  • Prior DevRel, Solutions Architecture, technical marketing, or partner-facing product experience

Why This Role Matters

  • Nexus is past GA and entering breadth. Adoption is real, but the next challenge is expansion across more teams, accounts, and use cases.

  • The foundation is landing now. Developer experience, connector foundations, and operator controls are the near-term unlocks.

  • The next wave is strategically important. Connector Ecosystem, Service Hub, and Agentic Communication Fabric could define how Temporal participates in the modern AI and service-connectivity stack.

  • You’ll shape an important product category. Nexus sits between durable execution, service-to-service communication, platform engineering, and AI systems.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Development
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal is looking for a Head of Corporate Development to own two connected mandates: sourcing and executing M&A that accelerates our product roadmap and market position, and building — from the ground up — a strategic seed investment program focused on companies building on top of the Temporal platform. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to combine classic corp dev rigor with the judgment of a platform investor. You will partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure every deal and every investment strengthens the Temporal ecosystem.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and manage the full M&A pipeline: identify targets, develop the strategic rationale, lead diligence, structure and negotiate terms, and drive deals through close and integration handoff.

  • Design and launch Temporal's ecosystem investment program — thesis, mandate, check sizes, sourcing pipeline, and governance — to invest in companies building on top of the platform.

  • Own investment execution end-to-end: sourcing, diligence, term negotiation, board/observer rights, and portfolio monitoring and reporting.

  • Partner closely with Product to align acquisition and investment targets with the platform roadmap, identifying where build, buy, partner, or invest is the right call.

  • Develop and maintain a market map of the Temporal ecosystem, tracking companies, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities for partnership, investment, or acquisition.

  • Build financial models and valuation analyses to support deal decisions and present clear recommendations to executive leadership and the board.

  • Manage relationships with bankers, lawyers, VCs, and founders, representing Temporal as a thoughtful, trusted counterparty in the ecosystem.

  • Establish scalable processes, templates, and governance for both M&A and investment activity as the programs mature.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of experience in corporate development, venture capital/growth investing, investment banking, or private equity, ideally with exposure to both M&A and minority investing.

  • A track record of sourcing, structuring, and closing deals independently, from first conversation to signed agreement.

  • Strong financial modeling, valuation, and diligence skills, paired with sound commercial judgment.

  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to translate technical and platform strategy into deal criteria.

  • Familiarity with developer tools, infrastructure, or platform ecosystems; direct knowledge of Temporal or workflow orchestration is a strong plus.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust with founders, investors, and internal executives alike.

  • Comfort operating with significant ambiguity — this role will define its own playbook.

WHY THIS ROLE

You'll build a net-new investment program from scratch while shaping Temporal's M&A strategy, working at the intersection of product, platform, and capital — with direct visibility to executive leadership and real influence over how the Temporal ecosystem grows.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Open Source Server
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal is looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Open Source Server team. This team builds and maintains the core Temporal server. Its scope is broad, including Matching, Applications, Foundations, task processing, quotas and throttling, visibility, developer-facing primitives such as standalone activities, schedules, and streaming, and workflow experience improvements such as Continue-As-New, pause, and reset. We do not expect one person to cover all of these areas. We’re looking for an engineer who is excited to learn the system, contribute to new and/or ambiguous projects across the codebase, and help improve the reliability, performance, operability, and developer experience of Temporal over time. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll collaborate with experienced engineers to design, build, and operate components of Temporal’s distributed systems platform while growing your skills in distributed systems engineering.

What You'll Do

• Design, implement, test, and ship well-scoped features and improvements for the Temporal server with support from teammates.

• Work on distributed systems problems in areas such as task matching, scheduling, workflow execution, visibility, quotas, throttling, persistence, developer primitives, and workflow lifecycle features.

• Make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs with guidance, balancing developer experience, performance, and operability requirements.

• Partner with engineers, product managers, cloud teams, and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Join our dynamic team as a Senior Application Security Engineer, where you'll play a pivotal role in securing the Temporal development pipeline, product, and customer execution environment. In this position, you'll work closely with software engineering teams and customers to build security deeply into our platform across multiple clouds. You'll also help shape how we use AI responsibly in both our product and our engineering processes. We're looking for individuals who are passionate about enabling engineering teams to build and ship securely, serving as trusted security partners across the organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate security principles into the design and architecture of products.

  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities and potential attack vectors across the full product surface.

  • Manage the Secure Development pipeline including code security and 3rd party library supply chain security.

  • Stay current on emerging standards and guidance (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MCP security specifications) and translate these into actionable internal policy.

  • Triage Bug Bounty findings and responsibility disclosed vulnerabilities.

  • Able to participate in on-call rotation.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 5+ years in application or product security or a related role.

  • Proven partnership with engineering teams, bringing security expertise to the planning and development process.

  • Knowledge of encryption, authentication, and secure communication protocols.

  • Familiarity with tools like SAST, DAST, and penetration testing frameworks.

  • A deep understanding of application architecture and design principles, ability to effectively identify vulnerabilities across multiple programming languages

  • Excellent communication and ability to explain complex security concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Kubernetes security posture management and auditing, including workload hardening, RBAC design, and admission control.

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-tenant security architecture, including data plane isolation, control plane hardening, and cross-tenant data leakage prevention.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

  • Expertise in at least one programming language, familiarity with Python and Go.

Nice to Have

  • Distributed computing and related vulnerability experience.

  • Running a Security Champions program.

  • Open Source automation or automation projects.

  • Expertise in other areas of security.

  • Security conference talks or published research.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Foundations (AI Agent Optimization)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We have an opening to hire a Staff Software Engineer - Agent Optimization

Temporal provides a reliable foundation powering AI leaders such as OpenAI, NVIDIA, Cursor, Lovable, and others. Its adoption is expanding to users spanning a broad range of AI applications ranging from agents to data pipelines and everything in between.

The mission of the AI Foundations team is to accelerate Temporal adoption across the entire ecosystem. Our approach combines a deep understanding of use cases with rigorous application of computer systems and software design principles.

In this role, you will lead our agent optimization efforts. You will design tools and mechanisms to help Temporal users build agents that are optimized for token spend and response time while maintaining result quality. Model routing is a first step, but represents the tip of the iceberg of techniques that we can apply. For example, multi-agent architecture, cache policy, and context management are all relevant. Candidates for this role should have direct experience with this problem domain.

You will work closely with other AI Foundations team members, e.g., those who focus on agentic development, maintaining a set of agents skills that lift performance of Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools for developers of Temporal applications. Other team members build ecosystem integrations or develop policy and security systems.

If you thrive on blending theory and practice, then this is the right team for you. We are an action-oriented group that loves to ship fast and solve customer problems. We also seek thorough technical grounding for our work and invest in systems and practices that foster long-term success.

Most of Temporal’s work is open source—see for yourself here: https://github.com/temporalio [new window]

What You'll Do

  • Work as a software engineer

  • Maintain and expand a deep understanding of agentic coding

  • Design and build agentic coding systems that we can trust to deliver high-quality outputs

  • Develop a deep understanding of AI application development patterns and techniques, including emerging approaches and architectures.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of new features, working with other teams to deliver exceptional reliability and a great developer experience.

  • Work with multiple programming languages: Python and TypeScript, Java, Go.

  • Serve as a domain expert on AI design patterns, collaborating with field staff to provide best-practices and canonical examples.

  • Work directly with our developer community to debug issues that need expert attention and get feedback on Temporal features and APIs.

  • Write public technical documentation describing Temporal concepts and APIs.

  • Go the extra mile to support a customer in need, on the rare occasion that our teams’ engineering expertise is needed.

  • Travel to meet your coworkers for a week once or twice a year.

  • Attend the occasional developer conference to talk about how great Temporal is (optional).

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of professional work experience.

  • Proven experience in optimizing AI systems using both machine learning and systems techniques

  • Experience and passion for harnessing generative AI, particularly for agents and coding.

  • A deep appreciation for how to use AI to improve quality, not only to increase quantity. 

  • A sense of taste in code and software development practice. Your approach should be opinionated and thoughtful, but not dogmatic.

  • Fluency in multiple programming languages, and an affinity for learning new ones.

  • Deep experience with concurrent programming—you should know how to use mutexes, atomics, and other concurrency primitives safely.

  • Experience designing APIs and writing documentation for publicly-available libraries or modules.

  • Strong technical communication skills—written and verbal—in English.

  • BS or MS in Computer Science (or a closely-related degree), or equivalent work experience writing production-grade software.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Temporal’s programming model (e.g. you’ve written an app on Temporal).

  • A track record of open source software contributions, including contributions to 3rd party libraries. 

  • Experience contributing to the architecture and design of large-scale distributed systems.

  • Deep background in machine learning, model training, data science, or machine learning systems.

  • Graduate degree in Computer Science.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Cloud Enablement
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We’re looking for a Software Engineer II to join Temporal’s Cloud Enablement team and help build and improve the Temporal Proxy. This role will focus on implementing core proxy capabilities and helping consolidate multiple proxy implementations into a single, extensible, open-source, and productized solution used by both customers and Temporal Cloud infrastructure.

Check out our code here!

What You'll Do

  • Implement features in a proxy codebase, contributing production-quality code (primarily in Go or a comparable systems language).

  • Build and improve core components such as request handling, configuration, authentication/authorization integrations, and encryption-related hooks (as defined by the team’s design).

  • Add and maintain observability (logs, metrics, traces) and contribute to debugging issues in staging/production environments.

  • Write and maintain tests (unit/integration) to improve correctness, prevent regressions, and support safe iteration.

  • Collaborate with engineers across CGS, Security, Infra Foundations, and OSS Server to deliver scoped projects and land changes safely.

  • Contribute to developer experience through clear documentation, examples, and small improvements that make the proxy easier to adopt and operate.

What You'll Bring

  • Proficiency in Go (preferred) or another systems language, with the ability to ramp quickly into an existing codebase.

  • Working knowledge of service-to-service communication and distributed systems basics (e.g., HTTP/gRPC, reliability fundamentals).

  • Familiarity with security fundamentals such as mTLS, JWT, and OIDC/OAuth concepts, and willingness to learn deeper patterns as needed.

  • Ability to take a scoped problem, implement a solution end-to-end (including testing and documentation), and communicate progress clearly.

  • A collaborative mindset and comfort working with teammates across functions to deliver shared outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • 3+ years of experience with proxy/gateway systems, cloud networking, service mesh concepts, or security-oriented infrastructure.

  • Experience with observability tooling and operational practices (on-call debugging, incident follow-ups, performance testing).

  • Contributions to open source (code or documentation).

  • Familiarity with Temporal concepts (or strong interest in learning the platform).

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Marketing Engineer, Core and SDKs
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Developers experience Temporal through its core programming model, SDKs, APIs, and tools. Those surfaces determine how quickly someone understands the product, whether they can build with it confidently, and whether they can move an application into production. They also shape how customers understand newer capabilities such as Nexus and Standalone Activities.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Marketing Engineer who can work in the product, find where developers struggle, and explain Temporal without hiding the technical details. You will work directly with Core and SDK engineers, developers, customers, Developer Relations, Documentation, Sales, and Solutions Architecture. You will turn what you learn into positioning, launch plans, sample applications, demos, technical guidance, and product recommendations.

Your primary charter is Core and SDKs. You may also investigate an AI pattern, integration, or other developer question when it depends on Temporal's programming model or developer experience.

What You Will Do

  • Develop a detailed understanding of Temporal's core primitives, SDKs, APIs, Nexus, and developer tools. Know how the experience differs across languages and where those differences matter.

  • Follow the developer journey from the first code sample through testing, debugging, deployment, versioning, and production use. Identify the points that slow adoption or create confusion.

  • Build demos, sample applications, reference implementations, tutorials, technical briefs, launch content, and field presentations. Use working code to support product claims.

  • Own positioning and messaging for assigned Core, SDK, API, Nexus, and developer experience initiatives with the Core Products Director. Define the audience, problem, value, evidence, and adoption path.

  • Work directly with Core, SDK, and developer tooling engineers to understand the roadmap and prepare for launches before the work is ready to announce.

  • Own the technical story for priority developer-tool integrations. Test how Temporal works with the frameworks, libraries, and tools developers already use, then create the examples and guidance needed to support adoption.

  • Test documentation, onboarding, local development, testing, debugging, replay, and upgrade workflows. Give Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, and Documentation specific recommendations based on what you find.

  • Support selected priority deals and partner conversations when hands-on work can answer a developer question, prove a claim, or remove an adoption blocker. Turn repeated questions into guidance the field can reuse.

  • Own customer interviews for Core and SDK case studies when it is your turn in Product Marketing's rotation. Capture what the customer built, why they chose Temporal, how they implemented it, and what changed as a result.

  • Take on another important developer question when priorities change, including an AI application pattern, a new integration, a competitive claim, or an emerging use case.

What You Will Bring

  • Extensive experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, customer engineering, developer relations, technical product marketing, or another hands-on technical role.

  • A record of building or supporting developer-facing platforms, SDKs, APIs, frameworks, or infrastructure products.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, or another language used to build backend applications, plus the ability to learn unfamiliar SDKs quickly.

  • Practical knowledge of APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, failure handling, state management, testing, deployment, and observability.

  • The ability to compare approaches, recommend a pattern, build a useful reference implementation, and explain the tradeoffs.

  • Excellent technical writing. You can turn working code and developer evidence into a clear position and guidance that experienced engineers will trust.

  • The credibility to lead a technical discussion with developers, a large Sales and Solutions Architecture audience, customers, and senior Product and Engineering leaders.

  • Independent judgment. You can find an important problem, define the work, and carry it through without waiting for a fixed backlog.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with event-driven systems, workflow engines, data infrastructure, or distributed applications.

  • Experience building SDKs, CLIs, testing tools, integrations, or open-source developer tools.

  • Experience supporting developer communities across more than one programming language.

What Success Looks Like After One Year

  • Core and SDK launches you support meet agreed targets for qualified signups, first-value activation, and adoption among eligible developers, backed by working examples and technical proof.

  • The priority deals you support show measurable impact through technical blockers resolved, stage progression, influenced ARR, and supported-deal win rate against a defined baseline.

  • Repeated developer and field questions become tested guidance, reusable examples, and specific product recommendations.

  • Product and Engineering act on documented findings about onboarding, SDK behavior, documentation, integrations, and the developer experience.

 - Own positioning and messaging for assigned Core, SDK, API, Nexus, and developer experience initiatives with the Core Products Director. Define the audience, problem, value, evidence, and adoption path.

 - Work directly with Core, SDK, and developer tooling engineers to understand the roadmap and prepare for launches before the work is ready to announce.

 - Own the technical story for priority developer-tool integrations. Test how Temporal works with the frameworks, libraries, and tools developers already use, then create the examples and guidance needed to support adoption.

 - Test documentation, onboarding, local development, testing, debugging, replay, and upgrade workflows. Give Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, and Documentation specific recommendations based on what you find.

 - Support selected priority deals and partner conversations when hands-on work can answer a developer question, prove a claim, or remove an adoption blocker. Turn repeated questions into guidance the field can reuse.

 - Own customer interviews for Core and SDK case studies when it is your turn in Product Marketing's rotation. Capture what the customer built, why they chose Temporal, how they implemented it, and what changed as a result.

 - Take on another important developer question when priorities change, including an AI application pattern, a new integration, a competitive claim, or an emerging use case.


WHAT YOU WILL BRING

 - Extensive experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, customer engineering, developer relations, technical product marketing, or another hands-on technical role.

 - A record of building or supporting developer-facing platforms, SDKs, APIs, frameworks, or infrastructure products.

 - Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, or another language used to build backend applications, plus the ability to learn unfamiliar SDKs quickly.

 - Practical knowledge of APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, failure handling, state management, testing, deployment, and observability.

 - The ability to compare approaches, recommend a pattern, build a useful reference implementation, and explain the tradeoffs.

 - Excellent technical writing. You can turn working code and developer evidence into a clear position and guidance that experienced engineers will trust.

 - The credibility to lead a technical discussion with developers, a large Sales and Solutions Architecture audience, customers, and senior Product and Engineering leaders.

 - Independent judgment. You can find an important problem, define the work, and carry it through without waiting for a fixed backlog.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with event-driven systems, workflow engines, data infrastructure, or distributed applications.

 - Experience building SDKs, CLIs, testing tools, integrations, or open-source developer tools.

 - Experience supporting developer communities across more than one programming language.

 - Core and SDK launches you support meet agreed targets for qualified signups, first-value activation, and adoption among eligible developers, backed by working examples and technical proof.

 - The priority deals you support show measurable impact through technical blockers resolved, stage progression, influenced ARR, and supported-deal win rate against a defined baseline.

 - Repeated developer and field questions become tested guidance, reusable examples, and specific product recommendations.

 - Product and Engineering act on documented findings about onboarding, SDK behavior, documentation, integrations, and the developer experience.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal is shaping the future of application development by enabling organizations to build, scale, and run resilient applications. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Strategic Account Executive to join our New Logo team and drive revenue within some of the largest and most complex enterprise organizations.

In this role, you will own a key sales territory, navigating matrixed enterprise companies and selling to highly technical personas such as software engineers, engineering leaders, and architects. As a strategic partner to our customers, you will bring a proven ability to lead sophisticated sales processes, uncover opportunities within massive organizations, and drive adoption of Temporal’s solutions. Your entrepreneurial mindset will help you thrive in a high-growth, startup environment, while your expertise in scaling revenue within complex organizations will make you an invaluable asset to our team.

Come work with some of the brightest minds in the tech industry and help transform how modern applications are built. You will contribute to the growth of a category-defining company at the forefront of innovation.

 
 

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to close, with a focus on growing revenue with new enterprise customers.

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to break into large, matrixed enterprise accounts.

  • Engage with software engineers, architects, and technical stakeholders to understand their needs and position Temporal effectively across a wide range of use cases.

  • Navigate complex technical discussions and align Temporal’s capabilities with customer priorities.

  • Build and nurture quality relationships with prospects, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process.

  • Partner with customer success, solutions architecture, and product teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Leverage your expertise in enterprise sales to identify and capture high-value opportunities within large, complex organizations, driving net-new customer acquisition.

  • Innovate and adapt sales strategies to meet the dynamic needs of enterprise businesses in a rapidly evolving market.

 

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated expertise in enterprise software sales, typically gained through 10+ years of experience in similar roles.

  • Proven track record of selling to software engineers, technical decision-makers, and engineering leaders.

  • Navigate complex technical discussions and collaboratively align Temporal’s capabilities with customer priorities.

  • Demonstrated success navigating and closing deals within large, matrixed enterprise organizations.

  • Experience driving high-growth sales motions within enterprise accounts, identifying opportunities, and scaling revenue.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a hands-on approach and entrepreneurial mindset.

  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with the ability to influence and build trust across multiple levels of an organization.

  • Demonstrated success in consistently achieving or surpassing revenue goals.

  • Experience working with cutting-edge developer tools or infrastructure products.

  • A passion for technology and a deep curiosity for solving complex customer challenges.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Replication Foundations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We’re hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join the Replication Foundations team within Temporal’s Cloud Global Services (CGS) organization.

Replication Foundations owns and evolves Temporal’s core replication stack in Temporal OSS—the distributed systems backbone behind key Temporal Cloud capabilities such as High Availability namespaces, cross-cluster and cross-region failover, and migration products that enable customers to move workloads between self-hosted Temporal and Temporal Cloud. The team also builds foundational scalability and reliability mechanisms that support Temporal at scale.

In this role, you’ll help set the technical direction for Temporal’s distributed replication systems. You’ll lead complex, correctness-critical initiatives spanning architecture, design, implementation, rollout, and operations. You’ll work across teams to evolve reliable and scalable replication capabilities that support both the open source project and Temporal Cloud.

 

What You'll Do

  • Set the technical direction and evolve the architecture of Temporal’s OSS replication stack, from problem definition through rollout and operational support.

  • Lead the design and implementation of replication protocols that power:

  • High Availability namespaces

  • Cross-cluster and cross-region replication

  • Migration between Temporal clusters, including cloud-to-self-hosted and cloud-to-cloud scenarios

  • Drive scalability and reliability initiatives such as:

  • Multi-cell namespaces

  • Enabling a namespace to span multiple clusters

  • Improving load distribution and handling hot spots

  • Define and communicate system-level guarantees, including consistency models, ordering, idempotency, failure recovery, performance, and operational behavior.

  • Identify architectural risks and opportunities, and shape the technical roadmap for replication capabilities that support current and future cloud products.

  • Partner with Cloud Enablement, CGS, Product, and other engineering teams to align OSS replication foundations with customer and product needs.

  • Lead design reviews, raise the quality of implementation and testing practices, mentor engineers, and provide technical guidance across the organization.

  • Lead or contribute to debugging complex production issues, incident response, and follow-up improvements related to replication and core system behavior.

What You'll Bring

  • A track record of designing and delivering complex production distributed systems, including systems where correctness, availability, and performance are critical.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals such as replication, partitioning, consistency, fault tolerance, durability, concurrency, and failure recovery.

  • Experience defining system architecture, protocol behavior, invariants, and trade-offs in ambiguous or evolving problem spaces.

  • Experience debugging complex production issues, including concurrency bugs, data inconsistencies, partial failures, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Proficiency writing production-quality concurrent code in Go; experience with Java, C++, or similar systems languages is also welcome.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex designs and trade-offs to both technical and cross-functional audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams, build alignment without direct authority, and mentor engineers.

  • A thoughtful and curious approach to understanding how systems behave under load, failure, and changing workload conditions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing or maintaining replication protocols or data-plane infrastructure.

  • Experience with multi-cluster or multi-region architectures, including active-active or active-passive systems.

  • Familiarity with database internals, log-based replication, or event-sourced systems.

  • Prior contributions to large open source projects or distributed systems infrastructure.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Nexus Server
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Summary

As a Senior Engineer, you will get the chance to design, build, and maintain significant portions of our backend functionality for highly scalable, multi-tenant Nexus services (Our durable execution framework for orchestrating work across team and application boundaries for improved modularity, security, debugging, and fault isolation). Examples of the key distributed systems components you’ll own include durable execution, async processing and expand our ability to invoke workflows through more industry standard protocols. Working in the highly collaborative Compute and Artificial Intelligence org, we’ll look to build a new enterprise offering that involves both on-premise and dedicated cloud offerings.

To learn more about Nexus and how our customers use Nexus here - [new window opens]

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement core backend service features for Nexus.

  • Provide appropriate test coverage for unit, integration, and performance for your feature ownership area.

  • Clearly document design choices and operational knowledge to successfully deploy and run service with those features.

  • Provide appropriate service level logs and metrics to make features operational for cloud service setup.

  • Provide appropriate alerts, dashboards, and runbooks for production.

What You Won’t Do

  • Work in an office (unless you want to, but you’d be by yourself). Temporal is a fully-remote company.

  • Commit code that’s poorly-tested or works “most of the time”. Temporal aspires to be “Reliable as Gravity”, and we expect your code to be the same.

  • Work behind closed doors. The SDKs are open source—that means PRs and comments are open to the public, too. See Temporal Git here.

  • Sit in meetings all day. We mostly communicate in writing, and use meetings mainly for status updates and thorny issues that need input from the whole group.

What You'll Bring

  • At least 6 years of experience in a production environment as an "Arranger" and/or "Builder/Enhancer" of highly scalable distributed systems. see HERE for more info re: "Arranger" and/or "Builder/Enhancer"

  • Solid computer science fundamentals in distributed systems concepts including multi-threading and concurrency.

  • 2+ years experience developing customer facing APIs and Frameworks

  • Experience writing concurrent code in production with languages like Go or Java or other applicable languages with skill level as "high end of Intermediate" and/or "Advanced" or "Expert" levels. see HERE for more info re: "high end of Intermediate" and/or "Advanced" or "Expert levels"

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Marketing Engineer, Competitive Intelligence
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal competes with products, internal systems, familiar habits, and the decision to do nothing. Customers may compare it with cloud workflow services, orchestration frameworks, job queues, databases, AI agent tools, or a platform they built themselves. We need to know which alternatives enter a deal, why Temporal wins or loses, and which differences matter to the customer.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Marketing Engineer to focus on competitive benchmarking and positioning and message. You will combine win-loss analysis, field evidence, pricing research, hands-on product evaluation, and reproducible benchmarks. You will use that evidence to improve positioning, help the field compete, and recommend changes to Product, Engineering, and company leadership.

This is a company-wide role. You will decide what we track, how claims are verified, how findings reach the field, and which issues require an executive decision. You will build the program rather than inherit one.

What You Will Do

  • Co-build Temporal's competitive intelligence program. Focus on benchmarking and thought leadership content and sales support.

  • Install, configure, and use competing products and adjacent technologies. Understand their architecture, developer experience, operational model, strengths, limits, pricing, and packaging.

  • Design and run fair, reproducible benchmarks and technical evaluations. Document the method, assumptions, environment, results, and limitations so others can trust the evidence.

  • Turn competitive evidence into positioning and reusable material for the field, including technical battlecards, comparison guides, objection handling, demos, internal briefings, launch input, and public technical content where appropriate.

  • Partner with the Solutions and GTM Director to triage recurring technical questions from Sales and Solutions Architecture. Determine whether the issue is a competitive claim, an architecture pattern, a product gap, or a one-off request, then define an answer the field can reuse.

  • Respond quickly to major competitor launches, product claims, pricing changes, market shifts, and high-stakes opportunities. Join selected deals when direct technical work can clarify the decision, then turn the answer into guidance the field can reuse. This role is not assigned presales capacity.

  • Build trusted relationships across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Gather intelligence through deal reviews, CRM, field submissions, competitor releases, pricing changes, community activity, and market research.

  • Provide deal support to key deals and turn those insights into thought leadership content.

  • Publish a monthly update for Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Solutions Architecture. Lead a quarterly executive review covering what changed, where Temporal is strong or exposed, and what Product or GTM should do next. Track each recommendation until it is accepted, rejected, or assigned.

  • Set a high evidence standard. State what we know, how we know it, where the comparison depends on workload or configuration, and where evidence is incomplete.

  • Partner with Enablement to turn competitive intelligence into training and field guidance. Measure coverage, freshness, response time, field usage, field confidence, competitive deal patterns, and influence on Product and GTM decisions.

  • Take on adjacent technical work when priorities shift, such as a launch, reference implementation, emerging competitor, or repeated customer problem.


What You Will Bring

  • A record of building or substantially improving a competitive intelligence program for a technical product. Your background may be in technical product marketing, solutions architecture, sales engineering, customer engineering, platform engineering, or a similar role. The program included win-loss analysis, technical evaluation, executive communication, product recommendations, and field adoption.

  • Hands-on knowledge of distributed systems, cloud platforms, application architecture, and the operational tradeoffs involved in running production software.

  • The ability to deploy and evaluate unfamiliar technology, read source code and technical documentation, build a test harness, and troubleshoot results.

  • Proficiency in these languages such as Go, Java, TypeScript, Python, C#, or PHP, plus comfort with containers, cloud environments, and automation tools.

  • Experience with performance or reliability testing and an understanding of latency, throughput, CPU, memory, storage, network, failure modes, and cost.

  • Clear writing, sound judgment, and confidence in the room. You can brief executives, guide the field through a contested deal, and defend the evidence with senior Product and Engineering leaders.

  • Intellectual honesty and strong judgment. You do not cherry-pick results or repeat a claim that cannot be supported.

  • Strong competitive positioning judgment. You can separate evidence from field folklore, focus the comparison on what matters to the customer, and state the tradeoffs honestly.

  • Independent execution across multiple workstreams and the ability to redirect quickly when a new competitor or customer needs matters more.

  • Have written meaty technical white papers and deliver them at key conferences.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with workflow engines, durable execution, event-driven systems, cloud workflow services, job systems, or AI agent frameworks.

  • Experience publishing technical benchmarks, comparison content, white papers, or open-source reference projects.


What Success Looks Like After One Year

  • Temporal has a trusted competitive repository, opportunity taxonomy, win-rate baseline, monthly update, and quarterly executive review.

  • Competitive win rate improves against priority alternatives, including build-it-yourself, while losses to status quo or no decision decline.

  • Product, Engineering, and GTM act on documented recommendations tied to competitive strengths, customer needs, and product or market gaps.

  • The field uses current guidance in competitive opportunities, priority deal support resolves hard technical objections, and the program scales without depending on you to join every deal.

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

 - Publish a monthly update for Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Solutions Architecture. Lead a quarterly executive review covering what changed, where Temporal is strong or exposed, and what Product or GTM should do next. Track each recommendation until it is accepted, rejected, or assigned.

 - Set a high evidence standard. State what we know, how we know it, where the comparison depends on workload or configuration, and where evidence is incomplete.

 - Partner with Enablement to turn competitive intelligence into training and field guidance. Measure coverage, freshness, response time, field usage, field confidence, competitive deal patterns, and influence on Product and GTM decisions.

 - Take on adjacent technical work when priorities shift, such as a launch, reference implementation, emerging competitor, or repeated customer problem.



WHAT YOU WILL BRING

 - A record of building or substantially improving a competitive intelligence program for a technical product. Your background may be in technical product marketing, solutions architecture, sales engineering, customer engineering, platform engineering, or a similar role. The program included win-loss analysis, technical evaluation, executive communication, product recommendations, and field adoption.

 - Hands-on knowledge of distributed systems, cloud platforms, application architecture, and the operational tradeoffs involved in running production software.

 - The ability to deploy and evaluate unfamiliar technology, read source code and technical documentation, build a test harness, and troubleshoot results.

 - Proficiency in these languages such as Go, Java, TypeScript, Python, C#, or PHP, plus comfort with containers, cloud environments, and automation tools.

 - Experience with performance or reliability testing and an understanding of latency, throughput, CPU, memory, storage, network, failure modes, and cost.

 - Clear writing, sound judgment, and confidence in the room. You can brief executives, guide the field through a contested deal, and defend the evidence with senior Product and Engineering leaders.

 - Intellectual honesty and strong judgment. You do not cherry-pick results or repeat a claim that cannot be supported.

 - Strong competitive positioning judgment. You can separate evidence from field folklore, focus the comparison on what matters to the customer, and state the tradeoffs honestly.

 - Independent execution across multiple workstreams and the ability to redirect quickly when a new competitor or customer needs matters more.

 - Have written meaty technical white papers and deliver them at key conferences.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with workflow engines, durable execution, event-driven systems, cloud workflow services, job systems, or AI agent frameworks.

 - Experience publishing technical benchmarks, comparison content, white papers, or open-source reference projects.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER ONE YEAR

 - Temporal has a trusted competitive repository, opportunity taxonomy, win-rate baseline, monthly update, and quarterly executive review.

 - Competitive win rate improves against priority alternatives, including build-it-yourself, while losses to status quo or no decision decline.

 - Product, Engineering, and GTM act on documented recommendations tied to competitive strengths, customer needs, and product or market gaps.

 - The field uses current guidance in competitive opportunities, priority deal support resolves hard technical objections, and the program scales without depending on you to join every deal.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing, Core Products
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Some of Temporal's most important product work begins inside Engineering. It may span the server, Cloud infrastructure, security, capacity, core primitives, SDKs, developer tooling, and AI without arriving as a finished market-facing roadmap. We need a senior product marketing leader who can earn Engineering's trust, understand what is coming, and decide which capabilities require positioning, technical proof, a launch, or a focused adoption plan.

Working directly with the VP of Product Marketing, you will own product-facing Product Marketing across Cloud and platform architecture, Core and SDKs, developer experience, and AI. You will manage a Principal-level Product Marketing Engineer and a Staff Product Marketing Engineer. You will also work closely with Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Documentation, Sales, Solutions Architecture, and the Solutions and GTM Director.

This is a working leader role. You will personally lead the most important product and portfolio narratives, launch decisions, and adoption programs with the VP. You will set priorities across the portfolio and bring Product Marketing into roadmap discussions early enough to affect the outcome. As the product and market change, you will adjust the team's priorities without losing ownership of the work already underway.

What You Will Do

  • Build direct, durable relationships with engineering leaders and individual engineers across Temporal, including technical areas that do not have dedicated Product Management coverage.

  • Maintain a clear view of the Product and Engineering roadmap. Assess each capability against customer need, market opportunity, competitive context, and GTM importance. Decide what requires research, positioning, technical proof, adoption guidance, a launch, or no external announcement.

  • Create and run Temporal's monthly edition and special edition launch process, including launch tiering, calendar, audience, narrative, proof, asset requirements, decision points, and cross-functional ownership.

  • Own product and portfolio positioning across Temporal's open-source technology, Cloud offering, core primitives, SDKs, pre-deployment and production features, and AI capabilities.

  • Explain the customer value of work on reliability, scalability, performance, availability, security, capacity, migration, and developer tooling without overstating or simplifying the claims.

  • Write and edit the positioning and messaging for the company's most important products and launches. Set the quality bar for product narratives across the team.

  • Own customer interviews as part of Product Marketing's rotating case-study program and set the quality bar for the team. Capture the customer's problem, decision, implementation, and results. Use that evidence in launches, adoption programs, and recommendations to Product and Engineering.

  • Hire, develop, and set priorities for the Product Marketing Engineers. Give them the access and authority to investigate important technical questions and turn their findings into proof, launch and adoption guidance, and specific product feedback.

  • Own Temporal's technology ecosystem strategy. Decide which partner categories and integrations matter, set the portfolio narrative, and coordinate joint launches with Product, Engineering, Business Development, the Product Marketing Engineers, and the Solutions and GTM Director.

  • Meet customers regularly at least 3 to 4 customers per month.

  • Regularly supporting strategic sales deals and collaborating with key sales stakeholders.

  • Make clear tradeoffs. Decide which launches need a full company motion, which need focused technical communication, and which do not need a launch at all.

What You Will Bring

  • Significant product marketing experience with developer tools, cloud infrastructure, open-source software, distributed systems, data infrastructure, or another deeply technical product.

  • Experience leading and developing senior individual contributors while remaining hands-on with strategy, writing, and execution.

  • A record of building trusted relationships with Engineering and turning technical work without a clear market plan into positioning, launch decisions, and adoption programs.

  • Enough technical fluency to discuss APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, reliability, performance, security, and cloud architecture with senior engineers.

  • Excellent positioning and writing skills. You can explain a technical capability accurately to developers and make its business value clear to architects and executives.

  • Sound judgment about priorities. You can distinguish a major market moment from a feature announcement and focus the organization accordingly.

  • Has experience working with a large global sales organization and producing high quality assets.

Experienced with Command of Message.

  • The judgment and presence to work as a peer with senior Product and Engineering leaders, make decisions within your charter, and lead large cross-functional discussions.

  • Comfort working in a growing company where the roadmap, market, and organizational boundaries continue to evolve.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience as a product manager, engineer, solutions architect, or other technical practitioner.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, event-driven systems, microservices, cloud platforms, or AI infrastructure.

  • Experience creating launch and product marketing systems in an organization that is still scaling.

What Success Looks Like After One Year

  • Priority products and capabilities meet agreed adoption targets among eligible users, measured against a pre-launch baseline and 30-, 60-, and 90-day goals.

  • Launches and adoption programs supported by the team increase qualified signups and conversion from signup to a defined first-value event.

  • Every high-priority roadmap area, including Engineering-led work without dedicated Product Management coverage, has a clear customer case, launch decision, and adoption plan.

  • Product and Engineering bring Product Marketing into important work early, and customer, field, and adoption evidence leads to documented roadmap, packaging, or product decisions.

  • Sales is supported across segments.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Product Marketing Engineer, Primitives
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Developers experience Temporal through its core programming model, SDKs, APIs, and tools. Those surfaces determine how quickly someone understands the product, whether they can build with it confidently, and whether they can move an application into production. They also shape how customers understand newer capabilities as Nexus and Standalone Activities.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Marketing Engineer who can work on the product, find where developers struggle, and explain Temporal without hiding the technical details. You will work directly with Core and SDK engineers, developers, customers, Developer Relations, Documentation, Sales, and Solutions Architecture. You will turn what you learn into positioning, launch plans, sample applications, demos, technical guidance, and product recommendations.

Your primary charter is Core Primitives and SDKs. You may also investigate an AI pattern, integration, or other developer question when it depends on Temporal's programming model or developer experience.

What You Will Do

  • Develop a detailed understanding of Temporal's core primitives, SDKs, APIs, Nexus, and developer tools. Know how the experience differs across languages and where those differences matter.

  • Follow the developer journey from the first code sample through testing, debugging, deployment, versioning, and production use. Identify the points that slow adoption or create confusion.

  • Build demos, sample applications, reference implementations, tutorials, technical briefs, launch content, and field presentations. Use working code to support product claims.

  • Own positioning and messaging for assigned Core, SDK, API, Nexus, and developer experience initiatives with the Core Products Director. Define the audience, problem, value, evidence, and adoption path.

  • Work directly with Core, SDK, and developer tooling engineers to understand the roadmap and prepare for launches before the work is ready to announce.

  • Own the technical story for priority developer-tool integrations. Test how Temporal works with the frameworks, libraries, and tools developers already use, then create the examples and guidance needed to support adoption.

  • Test documentation, onboarding, local development, testing, debugging, replay, and upgrade workflows. Give Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, and Documentation specific recommendations based on what you find.

  • Support selected priority deals and partner conversations when hands-on work can answer a developer question, prove a claim, or remove an adoption blocker. Turn repeated questions into guidance the field can reuse.

  • Own customer interviews for Core and SDK case studies when it is your turn in Product Marketing's rotation. Capture what the customer built, why they chose Temporal, how they implemented it, and what changed as a result.

  • Take on another important developer question when priorities change, including an AI application pattern, a new integration, a competitive claim, or an emerging use case.


What You Will Bring

  • Extensive experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, customer engineering, developer relations, technical product marketing, or another hands-on technical role.

  • A record of building or supporting developer-facing platforms, SDKs, APIs, frameworks, or infrastructure products.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, or another language used to build backend applications, plus the ability to learn unfamiliar SDKs quickly.

  • Practical knowledge of APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, failure handling, state management, testing, deployment, and observability.

  • The ability to compare approaches, recommend a pattern, build a useful reference implementation, and explain the tradeoffs.

  • Excellent technical writing. You can turn working code and developer evidence into a clear position and guidance that experienced engineers will trust.

  • The credibility to lead a technical discussion with developers, a large Sales and Solutions Architecture audience, customers, and senior Product and Engineering leaders.

  • Independent judgment. You can find an important problem, define the work, and carry it through without waiting for a fixed backlog.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with event-driven systems, workflow engines, data infrastructure, or distributed applications.

  • Experience building SDKs, CLIs, testing tools, integrations, or open-source developer tools.

  • Experience supporting developer communities across more than one programming language.

What Success Looks Like After One Year

  • Core and SDK launches you support meet agreed targets for qualified signups, first-value activation, and adoption among eligible developers, backed by working examples and technical proof.

  • The priority deals you support show measurable impact through technical blockers resolved, stage progression, influenced ARR, and supported-deal win rate against a defined baseline.

  • Repeated developer and field questions become tested guidance, reusable examples, and specific product recommendations.

  • Product and Engineering act on documented findings about onboarding, SDK behavior, documentation, integrations, and the developer experience.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.
